descriptions.en: Unleash your inner arcade hero. Inspired by the legendary duo Jillian and Lillian, these outfits bring their unstoppable energy and fearless fashion straight to Drifter and Operator. It’s nostalgia, reloaded!

此组合包内含：

- 御命织姬战甲
- 天薙刀长柄武器
- 晴日伞步枪
- 御命织姬女织头盔
- 命运掷骰表情动作
- 神乐舞表情
- 御命织姬提线投影
- 御命织姬提线纹章
- 御命织姬祈运坛装饰
- 520 白金

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

descriptions.en:
Sprint into action with the electrifying Volt Raijin Skin and antimatter-adorning Nova Aozakura Skin by adding both to your Arsenal today!

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
今天就将带电的伏特雷帝外观和反物质超能新星蓝樱外观添加到你的军械库中，一起冲锋陷阵！

此组合包内含：

- 超能新星蓝樱外观
- 伏特雷帝外观
- 170 白金

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

descriptions.en:
Outfit your Arsenal with a powerful Primary Weapon and Max Rank Mod! 

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
为你的军械库配备强大的主武器和最高等级的振幅晶体！ 


该组合包内含：

- 最高等级风鸣步枪
- 最高等级膛线振幅晶体
- 50 白金

每个账号只能购买该组合包一次。

descriptions.en:
Outfit your Arsenal with a powerful Primary Weapon and Max Rank Mod! 

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
为你的军械库配备强大的主武器和最高等级的振幅晶体！ 


该组合包内含：

- 最高等级风鸣步枪
- 最高等级膛线振幅晶体
- 50 白金

每个账号只能购买该组合包一次。

descriptions.en: Take on the dangers of the Origin System in style with the Pyra Opula Syandana and Sugatra. Back it up with the deadly Redeemer gunblade and High Noon Stance.
descriptions.zh: 使用缤纷珮菈背饰和坠饰，潇洒地应对始源星系的危险。更有致命的救赎者枪刃和正午架式助你一臂之力。

descriptions.en:
Strike a dangerous chord with the Encore Complete Collection! The newest Warframe, Temple, takes center stage along with new Gemini Skins and much more! Add it all to your Arsenal instantly with the Encore Complete Collection.

This collection features all contents from both the Encore Temple Bundle and Encore Gemini Collection.

This collection may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
通过安可完整组合包来拨动危险的弦！全新的战甲赤焰狂歌和全新的双子外观等更多精彩内容重磅登场！立即将安可完整组合包的全部内容添加到你的军械库中。

此组合包内含安可赤焰狂歌组合包和安可双子组合包的所有内容。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

descriptions.en:
Embolden the Hex's virtuous cause by adding this suite of Protoframe Gemini Skins and corresponding Gemini Emotes to your Arsenal.

This Collection includes:

- Flare Gemini Skin + Flare Gemini Emote
- Velimir Gemini Skin + Velimir Gemini Emote
- Minerva Gemini Skin + Minerva Gemini Emote
- Kaya Gemini Skin + Kaya Gemini Emote
- 475 Platinum

This collection may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
通过将这套原型战甲双子外观及和相应的双子表情动作添加至你的军械库，以壮大六人组的正义事业。

该组合包内含：
- 弗莱尔双子外观 + 弗莱尔双子表情动作
- 维利米尔双子外观 + 维利米尔双子表情动作
- 米尼娃双子外观 + 米尼娃双子表情动作
- 卡娅双子外观 + 卡娅双子表情动作
- 定量白金

每个账号只能购买该组合包一次。

descriptions.en:
Bring the house down by adding Temple's ruinous riffs, plus their signature Weapons and Customizations, to your Arsenal.

This bundle may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
将赤焰狂歌的毁灭之音，以及他的标志性武器和自定义装饰，加入你的军械库中。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

descriptions.en: Grow strong with Nokko, brave defender of the Deepmines.
descriptions.zh: 与深矿的勇敢捍卫者蘑菇小子一起成长。

descriptions.en: Stalk your prey through the floating islands of Duviri with the new Oraxia Bundle! Featuring the deadly hunter Oraxia, as well as her signature Weapons and Customizations.
descriptions.zh: 通过全新的缚影蛛后组合包，在双衍王境的漂浮岛屿上追踪你的猎物！内含致命猎手缚影蛛后，以及她的标志性武器和自定义装饰。

descriptions.en:
Summon the primordial legacy of the beast with the Rhino Heirloom Steel Collection. Featuring Customizations girded with living iron capable of withstanding any storm.

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
通过狂野犀牛传家宝钢铁组合包召唤出野兽的原始传承。以能够抵御任何风暴的活铁自定义装饰为特色。

该组合包内含：
-狂野犀牛传家宝外观
-狂野犀牛传家宝头环
-狂野犀牛传家宝调色盘
-狂野犀牛传家宝投影
-狂野犀牛传家宝纹章
- 狂野犀牛传家宝臻藏卡牌
- 190 白金

每个账号仅限购买此组合包一次。

names.zh: 狂野犀牛传家宝钢铁组合包

descriptions.en:
Instantly add this year's exclusive TennoCon items to your Arsenal, available now only for a limited time!

Keep in mind that with access to Baro's TennoCon 2025 Relay, you'll also be able to trade Ducats for every item Baro has ever sold.

The TennoCon 2025 Digital Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
即刻将今年专属的 TennoCon 物品添加到你的军械库，仅当下限时发售！

请记住，拥有访问虚空商人的 TennoCon 2025 中继站的权限，你可以使用杜卡德金币交易虚空商人出售过的所有物品。

TennoCon 2025 虚拟礼包为限时发售，每个账号仅限购买一次。

descriptions.en: Face harrowing memories of war and seek redemption - or retribution - in answer to the question: Can the Orokin ever be forgiven?
descriptions.zh: 面对战争的痛苦回忆，寻求救赎——或者复仇——只需以回答以下问题：奥罗金能否得到宽恕？

descriptions.en:
Deepen the bonds of camaraderie between the three unlikely companions of the Devil's Triad with this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh: 通过这组原型战甲双子外观，加深恶魔三重奏中三位看似不可能的伙伴之间的友谊。

descriptions.en: Call down brimstone-laced devastation and take command of demonic servitors with Uriel, the Heretic of Xata.
descriptions.zh: 与真理的异端者炼狱使徒一起，召唤硫磺带来的毁灭性灾难，并指挥恶魔的仆从。

descriptions.en: Valkyr rises in majesty, casting off her legacy of torment in the Valkyr Heirloom Collection! Heirloom Customizations signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno.
descriptions.zh: 瓦尔基里的崛起威风凛凛，在瓦尔基里传家宝组合包中摆脱了她苦难的过往。传家宝外观象征着时间的流逝和天诺的付出。

names.zh: 瓦尔基里传家宝组合包

descriptions.en: Embark upon an epic journey with this collection of skins and items for Wukong Qitian.
descriptions.zh: 与这套齐天大圣「齐天」外观及物品组合包一同踏上史诗之旅。

descriptions.en: Take on the dangers of the Origin System with the thundering power of the Fulmin rifle and shot-enhancing Split Chamber Mod. Do it all in style with the dazzling Opula Ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 手持威力震天的雷霆步枪，搭配增强射击效果的分裂膛室振幅晶体，直面始源星系的险境。身披耀眼的缤纷幻纹，以非凡姿态纵横战场。
身穿熠熠生辉的缤纷护甲套装，凭借冷冻光束步枪的冰冷火力和令人不寒而栗的光子过载振幅晶体，直面始源星系的险境。

descriptions.en: Make art your weapon, with the shadowgrapher Follie
descriptions.zh: 通过绘影者狂墨将艺术与你的武器完美融合。

descriptions.en: Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis: keep this inseparable odd couple together forever.
descriptions.zh: 迅电驰影摩托和暴食者暴坦：让这对形影不离的奇特组合永远在一起。
化身为冬日风暴之灵。舞霜剑姬锋利的细剑在呼啸的暴风雪之中舞动，剑气冲霄，即带来庇护，也带来毁灭。

descriptions.en: Confront the legacy of a doomed future. Is there room for harmony in the present?
descriptions.zh: 直面未来注定毁灭的宿命。当下是否还存在和平共处的空间？

descriptions.en:
Fight an eternal battle for the future with Vena, the blood-loving fanatic, and Ryoku, the cool and calculating killer. Two bitter rivals brought together in this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins. 

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh:
与嗜血狂热者维纳和冷静狡黠的杀手忍力一同，为未来展开一场永恒之战。这两位宿敌将在这组原型战甲双子外观中并肩作战。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

descriptions.en: What might have been becomes reality with Sirius & Orion. Assume the full might of dueling dark futures and follow the stars to constellations of combined power.
descriptions.zh: 在西里斯与奥里昂的交汇处，曾经的可能化为现实。感受两股黑暗未来交锋的磅礴之力，追随星辰，探寻众星的融合之力。

names.zh: 众星西里斯&奥里昂组合包

descriptions.en: Saunter into the fray and send outlaws to their graves with the Mesa Heirloom Collection. Let her Regulators echo a ballad beneath the high-noon sun.
descriptions.zh: 使用圣枪弥撒传家宝组合包，从容踏入战场，将亡命之徒送入黄泉。让她的监察者双枪在正午烈日下奏响一曲传奇。

names.zh: 圣枪弥撒传家宝组合包

descriptions.en: Instantly add this year's exclusive TennoCon items to your Arsenal, available now only for a limited time!
descriptions.zh: 即刻将今年专属的 TennoCon 物品添加到你的军械库，仅限时发售！

descriptions.en: Refine the legacy of a genius tactician with this collection of bold Heirloom items.
descriptions.zh: 通过这一系列大胆的传家宝物品，传承天才战术家的传奇。

names.zh: 工程统帅传家宝组合包

descriptions.en: Purchase Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, Weapons, Customizations and more from the in-game Market to reinforce your Arsenal. Weapons and Warframes can also be earned and crafted in-game for free. Platinum can also be used to instantly finish crafting items in the Foundry, or traded with other players in-game for rare items like Mods and Prime Warframe components.
descriptions.zh: 白金是游戏内的货币，可在游戏中的商店中用于购买战甲、武器、自定义装饰，以及更多物品，来强化你的军械库。武器和战甲也可以通过游玩任务免费获取并打造。白金还可用于在铸造厂中立即完成物品的打造，或在游戏里与其他玩家交易，换取例如振幅晶体和圣装战甲组件等稀有物品。

descriptions.en: Declare your devotion to the Zariman with this Glyph and Sigil for your profile.
descriptions.zh: 将这些投影和纹章加入你的个人档案中，向扎里曼表达你的忠诚。

descriptions.en: A collection of Noggle Statues depicting the followers of the Stalker.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含追猎者的追随者的摇头娃娃包。

descriptions.en: Show off your style, with this action packed collection of Warframe glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 用这款充满动感的战甲投影组合包展现你的风格。

descriptions.en: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的独家服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。适用于漂泊者与指挥官。

descriptions.en: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。适用于漂泊者与指挥官。

descriptions.en: Sneak behind enemy lines with this collection of scavenged Grineer Lancer armor. Fitted for The Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 使用这套克隆尼枪兵护甲组合包深入敌后。为漂泊者量身定制。

descriptions.en: Keep it real on the streets with this collection of thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这套灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

descriptions.en: Have the Operator or Drifter embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
descriptions.zh: 让指挥官或漂泊者穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

descriptions.en: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own. Now it can be the Drifter or Operator's too.
descriptions.zh: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有自身的风格。现在，漂泊者或指挥官也可以拥有同样的风采。

descriptions.en: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 漂泊者独孤游侠组合包

descriptions.en: A full pressure suit inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 一款以千纸鹤为灵感的密闭服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn's Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 诺拉从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 漂泊者凯勒套服组合包

descriptions.en: Lavos the Transmuter emerges from the seething smoke, the forgotten master of a much-misunderstood art. Includes the Lavos Warframe, Cordatus alternate helmet, Transmutation Probe decoration, Vitam Syandana, and Cedo Shotgun. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 炼制术师无限术士从翻腾的烟雾中出现，他是被人遗忘的大师，掌握一门被人误解的艺术。包括无限术士战甲、明智替换头盔、炼制探头装饰、命脉背饰，以及塞多霰弹枪。还包括 3 天经验值和星币加成。

descriptions.en: A collection of unique arrows, compatible with any bow.
descriptions.zh: 一套独一无二，适用于全弓类武器的箭矢组合包。

descriptions.en: A bundle featuring glyphs from Community Artist DarikaArt.
descriptions.zh: 组合包内含由社区艺术家 DarikaArt 设计的投影。

names.zh: 十一周年玩家社区投影组合包

descriptions.en: A collection of blueprints containing formulas to create every type of antidote.
descriptions.zh: 一系列用来合成各种解药的配方设计图。

descriptions.en: Hunt down your prey with this collection of lethal gear. Includes the Ivara Warframe, Rubico sniper rifle, Lacera sword-whip and the explosive Talon throwing darts. Enhance progression with 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 用这组致命的装备追捕你的猎物。道具包中包含神弓游侠战甲、绝路狙击枪、悲痛之刃剑鞭以及装载了爆破物的鹰爪飞镖。外加能协助你加快游戏进度的 3 天经验与星币加成。

descriptions.en: A collection of Noggle Statues depicting the followers of Arlo.
descriptions.zh: 一组代表了亚罗追随者们的摇头娃娃组合包。

names.zh: 拥护者摇头娃娃组合包

INSTANTLY REINFORCE YOUR ARSENAL!

Venture into the dark Void of the Zariman with a fully reinforced Arsenal! Add new Weapons, Customizations, Boosters and more to your Arsenal for a limited time, including the evolving Tenno badge of honor, the Vasero Sekhara, and the striking Hespar Scythe.

- Vasero Sekhara
- Hespar Heavy Scythe
- Galeforce Dawn Stance Mod
- Zariman Glyph*
- Zariman Sigil*
- 7-Day Resource Booster
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster

One per account. Items marked with a * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 "*" 的物品仅能通过这个组合包获取。

descriptions.zh: 为你的战甲、武器和同伴扩充军械库。

descriptions.en: Take your Warframe and Weapons to the peak of their power with the Complete Upgrade Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 通过完整升级组合包，让你的战甲和武器达到威力之巅。

descriptions.en: These pulsating ornaments are an ode to your dedication to The Conclave. Display them proudly in your ship.
descriptions.zh: 这些持续脉动着的装饰品是用来歌颂你对武形秘议的奉献。自豪地在你的飞船里展示它们吧。

names.en: Sun And Moon Oro Decorations Bundle
names.zh: 日月奥金之魂装饰品组合包

descriptions.en: Purchase 75 Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, weapons, consumables, sentinels, Mod packs, and a variety of other items from the in-game Market. It can also be used to instantly finish crafting wanted items in the Foundry.
descriptions.zh: 购买 75 白金。白金是游戏内的货币，可用于购买游戏内商店中的战甲、武器、消耗品、守护、振幅晶体组合包，以及其它多种物品，也能使铸造厂内的物品立刻完成制作。

descriptions.en: Purchase 170 Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, weapons, consumables, sentinels, Mod packs, and a variety of other items from the in-game Market. It can also be used to instantly finish crafting wanted items in the Foundry.
descriptions.zh: 购买 170 白金。白金是游戏内的货币，可用于购买游戏内商店中的战甲、武器、消耗品、守护、振幅晶体组合包，以及其它多种物品，也能使铸造厂内的物品立刻完成制作。

descriptions.en: Purchase 370 Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, weapons, consumables, sentinels, Mod packs, and a variety of other items from the in-game Market. It can also be used to instantly finish crafting wanted items in the Foundry.
descriptions.zh: 购买 370 白金。白金是游戏内的货币，可用于购买游戏内商店中的战甲、武器、消耗品、守护、振幅晶体组合包，以及其它多种物品，也能使铸造厂内的物品立刻完成制作。

descriptions.en:
Purchase 1000 Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, weapons, consumables, sentinels, Mod packs, and a variety of other items from the in-game Market. It can also be used to instantly finish crafting items in the Foundry.

Rare Mod includes:
- Seeking Fury – Rare Mod that increases reload speed and punch through.
descriptions.zh:
购买 1000 点白金，此货币可以用于购买游戏内商店中的战甲、武器、消耗品、守护、振幅晶体组合包，以及其他种类的道具。同时你也可以用白金加速完成铸造厂中建造中的道具。 

包含一张稀有振幅晶体：
- 狂暴追猎 - 稀有振幅晶体提升换弹速度与可穿透距离

names.zh: 1000 白金 + 一张稀有振幅晶体

descriptions.en:
Purchase 2100 Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, weapons, consumables, sentinels, Mod packs, and a variety of other items from the in-game Market. It can also be used to instantly finish crafting items in the Foundry.

Double Rare Mod includes:
- Animal Instinct – Rare Mod that increases loot radar and enemy sense.
- Seeking Fury – Rare Mod that increases reload speed and punch through.
descriptions.zh:
购买 2100 点白金，此货币可以用于购买游戏内商店中的战甲、武器、消耗品、守护、振幅晶体组合包，以及其他种类的道具。同时你也可以用白金加速完成铸造厂中建造中的道具。 

包含两张稀有振幅晶体：
- 动物本能 - 稀有振幅晶体提升战利品侦测范围和敌方感应范围
- 狂暴追猎 - 稀有振幅晶体提升换弹速度与可穿透距离

names.zh: 2100 白金 + 两张稀有振幅晶体

descriptions.en:
Purchase 3210 Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, weapons, consumables, sentinels, Mod packs, and a variety of other items from the in-game Market. It can also be used to instantly finish crafting items in the Foundry.

Triple Rare Mod includes:
- Armored Agility – Rare Mod that increases run speed and armor.
- Animal Instinct – Rare Mod that increases loot radar and enemy sense.
- Seeking Fury – Rare Mod that increases reload speed and punch through.
descriptions.zh:
购买 3210 点白金，此货币可以用于购买游戏内商店中的战甲、武器、消耗品、守护、振幅晶体组合包，以及其他种类的道具。同时你也可以用白金加速完成铸造厂中建造中的道具。 

包含三张稀有振幅晶体：
- 灵活装甲 - 稀有振幅晶体提升奔跑速度与护甲值 
- 动物本能 - 稀有振幅晶体提升战利品侦测范围和敌方感应范围
- 狂暴追猎 - 稀有振幅晶体提升换弹速度与可穿透距离

names.zh: 3210 白金 + 三张稀有振幅晶体

Triple Rare Mod includes:
- Armored Agility – Rare Mod that increases run speed and armor.
- Animal Instinct – Rare Mod that increases loot radar and enemy sense.
- Seeking Fury – Rare Mod that increases reload speed and punch through.
descriptions.zh:
购买 3125 点白金，此货币可以用于购买游戏内商店中的战甲、武器、消耗品、守护、振幅晶体组合包，以及其他种类的道具。同时你也可以用白金加速完成铸造厂中建造中的道具。 

包含三张稀有振幅晶体：
- 灵活装甲 - 稀有振幅晶体提升奔跑速度与护甲值 
- 动物本能 - 稀有振幅晶体提升战利品侦测范围和敌方感应范围
- 狂暴追猎 - 稀有振幅晶体提升换弹速度与可穿透距离

descriptions.en: A collection of restorative items to keep you and your teammates alive.
descriptions.zh: 保证你和你的队友生存的恢复包。

descriptions.en: The Shock-Camo skin for the Cestra.
descriptions.zh: 锡斯特的闪电迷彩外观。

descriptions.en: These bold patterns are designed to confuse the optical processing of both robotic and organic enemies.
descriptions.zh: 这些粗线条的样式设计是为了混淆机器人敌人和有机敌人的光学信息处理用的。

descriptions.en: The Shock-Camo skin for the Lanka.
descriptions.zh: 兰卡的闪电迷彩外观。

descriptions.en: Newly discovered composites are what makes this striking armor set possible.
descriptions.zh: 最新发现的复合材料使制作这套惊人的护甲成为可能。

descriptions.en: Arca weapons represent the bleeding-edge of Corpus research and fabrication. This bundle includes the Arca Titron hammer, Arca Plasmor shotgun, Arca Scisco scoped pistol, and the Arca armor set.
descriptions.zh: 弧电系列的武器代表着科普斯尖端的研究成果和制造工艺。这款组合包内包含弧电振子锤、弧电离子霰弹枪、带瞄准镜的弧电探知者手枪和弧电护甲套装。

descriptions.en: Energize your look with the full set of Porta decorative armor.
descriptions.zh: 用这套装饰护甲来为你的造型注入活力。

descriptions.en: Corpus craftsmanship applied to ancient principles creates this masterwork of defensive and aesthetic design. "Accept death, and escape it."
descriptions.zh: 科普斯工艺与古典原则的结合创造了这件兼具防御性和美学设计的杰作。"接受并逃脱死亡。"

descriptions.en: Profit from the latest in Corpus combat innovations. Contains the Stahlta rifle, Stropha gunblade and Shi Armor set.
descriptions.zh: 得益于最新的科普斯商会战斗创新。包含钢刃步枪 、诡计之刃，以及死逝护甲套装。

names.zh: 科普斯商会利益组合包

descriptions.en: Derived from Corpus protective technology, the Dendra decorative armor provides a unique look for any Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 起源于科普斯商会的防护技术，登德拉护甲提供给任何战甲一个独特的外观。

descriptions.en: This set of mechanized decorative armor is emblematic of the Corpus design aesthetic.
descriptions.zh: 这种机械化风格的装饰护甲象征了科普斯的设计美感。

descriptions.en: Master market forces with this collection of Corpus items. Includes the electrified Ohma Melee Weapon, Quaro Armor Set, Quaro Sugatra, and Sovereign Outcast Stance.
descriptions.zh: 用这组科普斯物品组合包掌控市场力量。其中包含带电的欧玛近战武器、求知护甲套装、求知坠饰和至尊浪人架式。

descriptions.en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
descriptions.zh: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。

descriptions.en: Dazzle friends and enemies alike, with this armor’s solar brilliance.
descriptions.zh: 这套护甲的太阳光辉让朋友和敌人都为之眩目。

descriptions.en: Nothing helps getting through Defense waves like a Dethcube. Also included are some customization options and an affinity booster to make your weekend even better.
descriptions.zh: 没有什么能比的上死亡魔方在防御战中提供的帮助。此外，这个特惠还包含了一些自定义外观与经验值加成，让你的周末更加美满。

names.zh: 死亡魔方周末活动特惠

descriptions.en: You are pestilence and plague with the Deimos Infested Bundle. Includes the Zymos Pistol, Keratinos Claws, and Sordario Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 通过火卫二感染组合包来成为最致命的肆虐异变。包括邪莫斯手枪、卡提努之爪和心瘤背饰。

descriptions.en: New weapons have emerged from the seething horror of the Infestation, each bringing a fresh, living aspect to their power. Featuring the bile-loaded Catabolyst Pistol, Proboscis Cernos Bow, Pulmonars Nunchaku, and the devastating Bubonico Arm Cannon.
descriptions.zh: 全新的武器已从感染者恐怖的攻击浪潮中浮现，每一把武器都带来了崭新的气象。拥有胆汁装填的异化者（手枪类武器）、刺吸西诺斯（弓类武器）、感染连枷（ 双截棍类武器）和毁灭性的横痃重炮（手炮类武器）。

descriptions.en: Transcend the chaos of battle. Baruuk Shaoshi's mystic runes show him the path to peace.
descriptions.zh: 超越战火的混乱。圣拳武僧少室的神秘符文为他指明了通往和平的道路。

descriptions.en: Baruuk Doan is the calm center of a chaotic storm. This collection includes the Baruuk Doan Skin, Harmatt Sparring Skin, and Khinn Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 圣拳武僧铃僧代表着混乱风暴中心的那份平静。组合包内含圣拳武僧铃僧外观、沙寂搏击外观和经行背饰。

descriptions.en: Venture boldly into the Otherworld with Caliban Orfeo. His collection includes the Caliban Orfeo Skin, Seighe Venato Skin, Heurodis Ephemera, and Heurodis Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通过卡利班奥菲欧勇闯异世界。他的组合包内含卡利班奥菲欧外观、见战脉纹外观和尤丽迪茜幻纹。

descriptions.en: Light the flame of eternal love with Citrine Aphrodita.
descriptions.zh: 用辉光晶灵美神点燃永恒之爱的火焰。

descriptions.en: Kindle Ember's elemental fire in its most refined form yet. Includes Ember Pyraxis Skin, Volca Syandana and Flamethrower Plazm Skin.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰的元素之火以其最精炼的形式点燃。内含永恒烈焰燃烬外观，熔焰背饰，以及火焰喷射器炎浆外观。

descriptions.en: Kick into high gear with the Gauss Moto Collection. The Saint of Altra enters a new era.
descriptions.zh: 迅电驰影摩托系列，助你火力全开。阿尔特拉圣者步入全新时代。

descriptions.en: Go full throttle with Gauss Kresnik. His fiery collection includes the Gauss Kresnik Skin, Bolide Syandana, and Acceltra Caduceus Skin.
descriptions.zh: 用迅电驰影火神全速前进。他那火一般的组合包内含迅电驰影火神外观、火流星背饰以及迅发电浆炮 双蛇外观。

descriptions.en: Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis: keep this inseparable odd couple together forever.
descriptions.zh: 迅电驰影摩托和暴食者暴坦：让这对形影不离的奇特组合永远在一起。

descriptions.en: Gain new appreciation for mastication with the Grendel Turbis collection. Those who see what lies within his gaping maw rarely live to tell the tale.
descriptions.zh: 通过暴食者暴坦系列，重新领略咀嚼的真谛。能亲眼目睹他巨口深处的人，鲜少能活下来讲述这段经历。

descriptions.en: Gyre crackles to life in this collection themed around archaic experimental technology.
descriptions.zh: 在这个以古老的实验技术为主题的组合包中，电光舞者充满了活力。

names.zh: 电光舞者电涡幽灵组合包

descriptions.en: Hildryn arises anew, re-forged in the fires of finest smith-craft. Add splendor to her saga with this collection of deluxe items. Includes the Hildryn Einheri Skin, Blodgard Heavy Blade Skin and the Brising Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 重装武神在工匠之火中淬炼重生。用这款华丽组合包为她的传奇故事增光添彩。内含重装武神英灵外观、血卫巨刃外观，以及煦珀背饰。

descriptions.en: Transform the captive Warframe’s burden of blame into a smoldering mark of pride with this collection of Apostate skins and items.
descriptions.zh: 使用叛徒外观和物品组合包，将被囚禁战甲背负的自责转化为骄傲的燃烧印记。

descriptions.en: Master the art of transmutation with this collection of skins and items for Lavos Khymia.
descriptions.zh: 掌握炼制术之奥秘——无限术士点金外观与装备组合包。

descriptions.en: Explore the realms of Sentient design with these skins for Volt and Mesa, showing them as they would have appeared if the Sentients had created them.
descriptions.zh: 通过这些为伏特和圣枪弥撒打造的外观来探索灵煞的设计领域，该组合包展示了他们若是由灵煞创造将会拥有的样貌。

names.zh: 灵煞视界豪华外观组合包

descriptions.en: Infuse your style with the grace of drifting sakura petals. This bundle includes Nova Aozakura’s signature accessories.
descriptions.zh: 让飘舞的樱花花瓣为你的风格增添优雅气息。此组合包内含超能新星蓝樱的标志性配件。

names.zh: 超能新星蓝樱配件组合包

descriptions.en: Choose the path of wisdom with the Dante Tytonis Collection. His dark wings harbor secret knowledge and arcane power.
descriptions.zh: 使用缮写士夜鹰组合包，踏上智慧之路。他那幽暗的羽翼蕴藏着不为人知的知识和神秘的力量。

descriptions.en: Protea Caladrius disheartens enemies as she emboldens her allies. This collection includes the Protea Caladrius Skin, Daecret Tonkor Skin, and Monitivus Thrown Weapon Skin.
descriptions.zh: 泊时灵械医官鸟在给盟友壮胆的同时让敌人灰心丧气。这款组合包内含泊时灵械医官鸟外观、征服榴炮圣裁外观和投掷武器警世外观。

names.zh: 泊时灵械医官鸟组合包

descriptions.zh: 驱散邪恶。辐能堡垒圣殿以他的骇人身姿令那些企图恐吓他人之徒不寒而栗。

descriptions.en: Dwell in the eternal twilight with Revenant’s haunting Mephisto collection.
descriptions.zh: 通过徘徊夜灵令人不安的梅菲斯特组合包栖身九界间的永恒黄昏中。

names.zh: 徘徊夜灵梅菲斯特组合包

descriptions.en: Take on a touch of the devil with these Revenant Mephisto Operator accessories.
descriptions.zh: 通过这些徘徊夜灵梅菲斯特指挥官配件来感受一丝恶魔的气息。

names.zh: 徘徊夜灵梅菲斯特指挥官组合包

descriptions.en: Turn legend into reality. This collection includes Sevagoth Glaukus, his loyal companion Bosun Gillychap, a custom Tombstone, and the Cirriped Epitaph Skin. It also features Sevagoth's Lullaby, a custom song that plays for Sevagoth's Shadow in combat and can be played on the Somachord in your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 把传说变为现实。该组合包内含虚冥鬼影格劳克斯、他的忠实同伴水手长吉利鱼、一个可自定义的墓碑、以及葬铭蔓足外观。它还包括虚冥鬼影的安眠曲——一首在战斗中为虚冥鬼影的幽影播放的自定歌曲，该曲目也可在轨道飞行器中使用身心和弦琴播放。

names.zh: 虚冥鬼影格劳克斯组合包

descriptions.en: The warrior spirit reincarnates in the image of a god. His collection includes the Tequihua Polearm Skin, Huitzilin Syandana, and Chimalli & Tequihua Decoration for your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 战士精神以神明的形象转世。他的组合包内含战矛长柄武器外观、蜂鸟灵背饰，以及战盾 & 战矛轨道飞行器装饰。

names.zh: 无畏斗士炽阳神组合包

descriptions.en: Assume the lethal form of a lustrous midnight. This collection includes the Titania Donann skin, Titania's Moyturan Wings, the Aerospri Dex Pixia Skin, the Hawth Diwata Skin, and the Raylta Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 化身为皎洁之夜的致命形态。该组合包内含幻蝶仙灵大地女神外观、幻蝶仙灵莫伊图兰翅膀、灵敏妖精空灵外观、仙女赤爪外观，以及星翼背饰。

names.zh: 幻蝶仙灵大地女神组合包

descriptions.en: Fear and awe will be seen in your enemies’ eyes when they behold the great berserker. Her collection includes the Valkyr Carnivex Skin, Dreyric Fist Skin, and Alastorn Armor.
descriptions.zh: 当伟大的狂战士出现时，你将从敌人的眼中看到恐惧和敬畏。这款组合包内含瓦尔基里行刑者外观、沁血拳套外观，以及魔使护甲。

names.zh: 瓦尔基里行刑者组合包

descriptions.en: Claim attire forged to conquer the storm. This bundle includes Volt Raijin’s signature accessories.
descriptions.zh: 获取为征服风暴而打造的装束。此组合包内含伏特雷帝的标志性配件。

descriptions.en: Beauty meets chaos. This collection includes accessories for both Volt Raijin and Nova Aozakura.
descriptions.zh: 美感与混沌的交融。此组合包内含伏特雷帝和超能新星蓝樱的配件。

descriptions.en: Embody the fury of the storm and the grace of sakura petals that float upon the water. This collection includes both Volt Raijin and Nova Aozakura.
descriptions.zh: 体现风暴的狂怒和樱花花瓣漂浮在水面上的优雅。该组合包内含伏特雷帝和超能新星蓝樱。

descriptions.en: Invoke Voruna Medeina, the forest goddess. Her savagery is a blessing to those who hunger for justice.
descriptions.zh: 祈求森林女神赤影狼母梅迪娜的庇佑。她的狂野对渴望正义的人来说是一种祝福。

names.zh: 赤影狼母梅迪娜组合包

descriptions.en: Natural and preternatural combine in Wisp Somnium. This collection includes the Wisp Somnium Skin, Subvolv Syandana, and Privolv Fulmin Skin.
descriptions.zh: 离火幻灵星梦是自然与超自然的结合体。该组合包包括离火幻灵星梦外观、月阳背饰和月阴雷霆外观。

descriptions.en: Embark upon an epic journey with this collection of skins and items for Wukong Qitian.
descriptions.zh: 与这套齐天大圣「齐天」外观及物品组合包一同踏上史诗之旅。

descriptions.en:
The Void reimagines broken Orokin treasures. In these manifestations of Xaku’s memories, remnants of warfare meet fragments of artistry. The collection includes Xaku Kagura, Lotus Amaga, the Lohk’s Embrace Ephemera, Xaku and Lotus Mended Glyphs, and Gallixware ceramic decorations for your Orbiter.

Complete The New War Quest to unlock Lotus customization.
descriptions.zh:
虚空重塑了破碎的奥罗金珍宝。在虚空残响记忆所生成的显化中，战争的残响与艺术的碎片相遇。本系列组合包内含虚空残响神乐外观、天女之莲外观、虚空之拥幻纹、虚空残响和莲之复苏投影，以及为轨道飞行器定制的高力士陶瓷装饰。

需要完成《新纪之战》系列任务来解锁莲的自定义装饰。

descriptions.en: Strike forth from the watery depths with the power of Yareli Pandea. Her collection includes the Yareli Pandea Skin, Nidoblast Kompressa Skin, Rubra Sugatra, Merulina Pandea Skin and the Merulina Pandea Domestik Drone.
descriptions.zh: 借助咏浪之灵盘古底的力量从水深之处发起攻击。她的组合包内含咏浪之灵盘古底外观、刺触卡帕压力枪外观、赤蜇坠饰、浪漪珊瑚盘古底外观和浪漪珊瑚盘古底内务无人机。

names.zh: 咏浪之灵盘古底组合包

descriptions.en: Soar to new heights as Zephyr with this turbocharged deluxe collection. Includes Zephyr Harrier Skin, Arclite Landing Craft Skin and Zephyr Harrier Theme.
descriptions.zh: 用这款涡轮增压的华丽外观来让狂啸西风翱翔在新的高度。包含狂啸西风鹞式外观、弧光登陆艇外观和狂啸西风鹞式主题。

descriptions.en: A bold, radical look that tells everyone you rule the skies. Includes Harrier Suit, Harrier Sleeves, Harrier Leggings, and Harrier Hood. Fitted for the Operator and the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 通过大胆、激进的造型来告诉大家你是天空的主宰。包括鹞式套服、鹞式袖件、鹞式绑腿和鹞式头罩。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en:
This bundle offers unparalleled opportunity for maximum destruction.

It includes the Elytron Archwing, perfect for the demolition specialist, and comes outfitted with the powerful Onorix axe and Corvas cannon.
descriptions.zh:
为达到最高的破坏力，这个组合包提供了前所未有的一个机会。

内含的鞘翅曲翼，完美地专精于破坏，并配备了强悍的奥努里克斯战斧与黑鸦加农炮。

descriptions.en: A desert camouflage skin pack for your Grineer arsenal.
descriptions.zh: 为你呈现克隆尼军械库的沙漠迷彩外观包。

names.zh: 克隆尼沙漠战术包 II

descriptions.en: A collection of glyphs created by artists in the Warframe community.
descriptions.zh: 一组来自星际战甲社区的艺术家创作的投影。

descriptions.en: Bring home the familiar faces of the Devil’s Triad - whether friends or enemies, now cuddly for your convenience!
descriptions.zh: 把《恶魔三重奏》中熟悉的面孔带回家——无论是朋友还是敌人，现在都变成了适合拥抱的可爱玩偶！

names.zh: 软萌三重奏玩偶组合包

descriptions.en: An entire set of Gazal armor.
descriptions.zh: 一整套加扎勒护甲

descriptions.en: Become wrapped in mystery with complete set of Gazal skins and armor. Includes bonus Djinn Sentinel.
descriptions.zh: 用一整套加扎勒外观和护甲来变得神秘，包含额外的引灵守护。

descriptions.en: Keep the Orbiter in spotless condition with the latest in Corpus sanitation technology.
descriptions.zh: 使用科普斯最先进的卫生科技来维持一尘不染的轨道飞行器环境。

descriptions.en: Dual Ether and the dual-wielded Afuris in one special weekend package. Add in a bonus Affinity Booster to double the speed of leveling them up.
descriptions.zh: 苍穹双剑以及双持盗贼双枪就在这特别的周末组合包中！附带的经验值加成道具让您的升级速度倍增！

descriptions.en: Get the Chroma Warframe and the latest weaponry to hit the market, along with boosters to level your new gear faster!
descriptions.zh: 取得怒炎龙骑战甲与最新上市的武器，组合包内含加成道具使您的装备升级更加快速！

descriptions.en: Dress your Kaithe as Rakhali, Dagath's noble steed. This collection includes the Aumen Chamfron, Saddle, and Tail.
descriptions.zh: 把你的绝灵骥打扮成无面骑影的高贵骏马拉卡里。其中包含金兆马盔、马鞍和马尾。

descriptions.en: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.
descriptions.zh: 喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚，它的震地攻击和重型震地攻击具有更广的影响范围。

descriptions.en: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.
descriptions.zh: 业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。它的重击会发出冲击波。

descriptions.en:
Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

When purchased in the Market this Duviri melee weapon will be available for immediate Warframe use in the Arsenal and for the Drifter in Duviri.
descriptions.zh:
星舟 & 帆为坚忍不拔的战士提供支持。它的重击会射出一把会在敌人身上弹开的刀刃。

在游戏内商店购买这把双衍王境近战武器后，它将立即可供军械库中的战甲使用，同时也可供双衍王境中的漂泊者使用。

descriptions.en: Edun befits dexterous warriors. Power Strike knocks down and blinds enemies by surrounding them with a cloud of dust.
descriptions.zh: 雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。使用强力攻击激起一团环绕敌人的尘雾，从而击倒并致盲他们。

descriptions.en: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.
descriptions.zh: 溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。同时进行格挡和近战攻击来将溶灵尊插入地面，用其冲击波伤害附近的敌人，并增加连击计数。

descriptions.en: Stride into the fray with fractal elegance.
descriptions.zh: 以变幻的优雅之姿阔步迈入战场。

descriptions.en: Dress just like the hero described in the famous storybook, Tales of Duviri. The Fabled Warrior Pack includes the Aesopex Armor, Gabrai Kavat Armor, Drifter Loneryder Suit, Lonesome Shawzin, and Only Beyond Vistagraph.
descriptions.zh: 照着著名的《双衍王境故事集》中的英雄形象来着装。传奇战士组合包内含伊索派斯护甲、伽勃利库娃护甲套服、漂泊者独孤游侠套服、孤寂三线琴和唯有彼方景幕。

descriptions.en: A Duviri-themed pack featuring a Glyph and Display made by community artists.
descriptions.zh: 一个双衍王境主题组合包，内含一个由社区艺术家制作的投影和展示图。

names.zh: 双衍王境社区艺术组合包

descriptions.en: In Tales of Duviri, good riders ensure their Kaithes are well-appointed. The Steed's Regalia Pack includes distinctive tails, chamfrons, and a saddle.
descriptions.zh: 在《双衍王境故事集》中，优秀的骑手确保他们的绝灵骥装备精良。华服骏马组合包内含独特的马尾、马盔和马鞍。

descriptions.en: Tales of Duviri tells of Aetigo Kaithes that roamed verdant plains. The Grassland Steed Pack brings that aesthetic to life.
descriptions.zh: 《双衍王境故事集》中讲述了漫游在青翠平原上的因理绝灵骥。草原骏马组合包将这种美学带到了现实生活中。

descriptions.en: Tales of Duviri tells of Psyacus Kaithes that inspired fear in the faint of heart. The Outland Steed Pack embodies a courageous aesthetic.
descriptions.zh: 《双衍王境故事集》中讲述了使胆小者恐惧的心道绝灵骥。外域骏马组合包体现了一种勇敢的美学。

descriptions.en: Strike your enemies down with weapons that are just as elegant as they are powerful. The Heavy Strike Melee Bundle includes the Azothane, Syam, Edun, and Sampotes melee weapons.
descriptions.zh: 用优雅而强大的武器痛击你的敌人。猛力重击近战组合包内含溶灵尊、业珀、雷石祭和三宝聚近战武器。

descriptions.en: Get Volt and all his favorite gear.
descriptions.zh: 获得伏特和他的御用装备。

descriptions.en: Rise from the ashes with this flamboyant collection. Includes Ember Vermillion Skin, Nusku Pistol Skin and Bennu Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用这款火焰般的组合包从灰烬中再生。包含了永恒烈焰朱红外观，努斯库手枪外观和班努鸟背饰。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Ember in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Ember Voidshell Skin and Phenaureus Bark material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含永恒烈焰虚空之壳外观以及樟子松树皮材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 永恒烈焰虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en: Customize your Sentinels to give them the deep-sea look of the Nautilus with this cosmetics bundle. Includes Wings, Mask and Tail. Does not include Nautilus Sentinel.
descriptions.zh: 通过这件装饰组合包来自定义你的守护，让他们具有深海鹦鹉螺外观。组合包内含守护飞翼、面具，以及尾部，但不包含鹦鹉螺守护本体。

names.zh: 鹦鹉螺守护装饰组合包

descriptions.en: Equip yourself with the efficient, deadly Nautilus Sentinel, the ideal companion for Railjack voyages. The Nautilus can repair shipboard hazards independently and haul enemies together for ease of targeting. Includes Wings, Mask and Tail cosmetic accessories.
descriptions.zh: 为你自己装备高效且又致命的鹦鹉螺守护，它是航道星舰航行的理想同伴。鹦鹉螺可以自行修复舰上的安全隐患，并把敌人拖到一处以便于瞄准。组合包内含守护飞翼、面具，以及尾部装饰配件。

descriptions.en: Claim first blood with Unreal Tournament weapon skins for Ogris, Drakgoon, and Stahlta.
descriptions.zh: 使用食人女魔、龙骑兵和钢刃步枪的虚幻竞技场外观赢得第一滴血。

names.zh: 虚幻竞技场外观组合包

descriptions.en: Kill with contrast using this signature collection for Equinox. This collection includes the Equinox Antonym Skin, Astreos Sword and Shield Skin and Circadian Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 使用这个阴阳双子标志性组合包来利用其昼夜面来消灭敌人吧。其中包括阴阳双子悖异外观，星辰剑盾外观和节律背饰。

descriptions.en: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
descriptions.zh: 这个套组的武器振幅晶体让你可立即以 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！

names.zh: 冰冻伤害振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons' Critical Chance. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
descriptions.zh: 这个套组的武器振幅晶体可以让你立即提高武器的暴击几率。也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落，以及其它方式来获取这个组合包内的所有物品！

names.zh: 暴击几率振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons' Base Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
descriptions.zh: 这个套组的武器振幅晶体让你可立即提升武器的基础伤害。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！

names.zh: 基础伤害振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
descriptions.zh: 这个套组的武器振幅晶体让你可立即以 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！

names.zh: 电击伤害振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: A bundle featuring new Mods for Tome weapons like the Grimoire. These Mods enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat.
descriptions.zh: 该组合包内含魔典等典籍武器的全新振幅晶体。这些振幅晶体可提升战甲技能并鼓励策略战斗。

names.zh: 基础典籍振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
descriptions.zh: 这个套组的武器振幅晶体让你可立即以 <DT_HEAT>火焰伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！

names.zh: 火焰伤害振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: Recall the ancient art of Tennokai with these Melee Weapon Mods. Everything in this pack can also be earned from Alchemy Missions in Albrecht's Laboratories on Deimos.
descriptions.zh: 通过这些近战武器振幅晶体，重温古老的天诺战士气解之艺。本组合包中的所有物品都可以从火卫二上阿尔布雷希特的实验室中的元素转换任务获得。

names.zh: 基础天诺战士气解振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
descriptions.zh: 这个套组的武器振幅晶体让你可立即以 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！

names.zh: 毒素伤害振幅晶体组合包
奥罗金催化剂和奥罗金反应堆

descriptions.en: A cache containing various 7 Day Boosters
descriptions.zh: 一个内含各种 7 天加成器的储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing a large amount of Endo
descriptions.zh: 一个内含大量内融核心的储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing 3 Exilus Adapters
descriptions.zh: 一个内含 3 个特殊功能槽连接器的储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing a large amount of Kuva
descriptions.zh: 一个内含大量赤毒的储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing 3 Forma
descriptions.zh: 一个内含 3 个塑形块的储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing 3 Melee Riven Mods
descriptions.zh: 一个内含 3 张近战裂隙振幅晶体的储藏箱

names.zh: 近战裂隙振幅晶体储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing 3 Rifle Riven Mods
descriptions.zh: 一个内含 3 张步枪裂隙振幅晶体的储藏箱

names.zh: 步枪裂隙振幅晶体储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing 3 Pistol Riven Mods
descriptions.zh: 一个内含 3 张手枪裂隙振幅晶体的储藏箱

names.zh: 手枪裂隙振幅晶体储藏箱

descriptions.en: A cache containing 4 Weapon slots
descriptions.zh: 一个内含 4 个武器槽位的储藏箱

descriptions.en: The System is yours with this Excalibur Zato-inspired cosmetic collection for your Operator. Includes Zato Oculus, Zato Earpiece and Zato Facial Accessory for your Operator.
descriptions.zh: 当你的指挥官装备这个由圣剑盲侠启发的涂装组合包，这个星系是属于你的了。其中包括：盲侠眼饰、盲侠耳饰和盲侠脸部装饰。

descriptions.en:
Wander the world, beholden to none. The Excalibur Zato Collection includes the Excalibur Zato Skin, Zato Sugatra and the Oku Nikana Skin.

Includes Excalibur Zato Agile and Noble animation sets.
descriptions.zh:
只身一人，流浪天涯。圣剑盲侠组合包内含圣剑盲侠外观、盲侠坠饰和大奥侍刃外观。

也包括圣剑盲侠迅捷和尊贵站姿。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Excalibur in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Excalibur Voidshell Skin and Lunaro Striker material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含圣剑虚空之壳外观以及皎月先锋材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en:
Show your power and mystique with the Xbox One Exclusive Warframe®: Prestige Pack I.

Emanating with the colors of Xbox One, the Exclusive Jade Excalibur Skin will make your allegiance clear on the field of battle. 

Also included is Platinum to super charge your arsenal.

This Pack includes:
- 170 Platinum
- Xbox One Exclusive Excalibur Jade Skin*

* SKIN ONLY, Excalibur Warframe not included.

This item may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
用 Xbox One 限定版的星际战甲®: 荣耀威望包 I 展现你的神秘和力量。让 Xbox One 的颜色迸发，限定版 碧玉圣剑外观会在战场上明确地展现你的忠诚。

组合包中还包含扩充军械库的白金。

这个组合包中包含:
- 170 白金
- Xbox One 限定版圣剑翡翠外观*

* 只含外观，圣剑战甲不包含在其中。

每个账号只限购买这个物品一次。

names.zh: 荣耀威望包 I - 限定版

descriptions.en: A sigil and an emblem commemorating the Tenno's victory over Nef Anyo.
descriptions.zh: 纹章和徽章各一枚以纪念天诺战士战胜奈富·安尤。

descriptions.en: False Profit Mod Pack
descriptions.zh: 变造利益行动振幅晶体包

names.zh: 变造利益行动振幅晶体包

descriptions.en: A series 2 helmet for Banshee, Ember, Nyx, Mag, Saryn, Trinity and Nova!
descriptions.zh: 恸哭女妖、永恒烈焰、冥河夜神、磁力、剧毒之触、三位一体和超能新星的第二系列头盔！

descriptions.en: Unlock Mag, Trinity, and Ember Warframes.
descriptions.zh: 解锁磁力、三位一体和永恒烈焰三副战甲。

descriptions.en: Unlock Saryn, Banshee and Nyx Warframes.
descriptions.zh: 解锁剧毒之触、恸哭女妖和冥河夜神三副战甲。

descriptions.en: A series of Mods awarded to players who contributed to the Eyes of Blight event.
descriptions.zh: 一系列振幅晶体给予在毁灭之眼事件付出心力的玩家。

names.zh: 毁灭之眼振幅晶体组合包

descriptions.en: Includes the FLUCTUS RAHK SKIN and the EYES OF BLIGHT EMBLEM.
descriptions.zh: 内含拉克巨浪外观与毁灭之眼徽章

descriptions.en: A collection of three Formas.
descriptions.zh: 内含 3 个塑形块的组合包。

descriptions.en: This massive bundle combines the Garuda Collection and the Orb Vallis Survival Collection. Includes the Garuda Warframe, Nagantaka Crossbow, Garuda Bathory Helmet, Suparna Syandana, Battacor Rifle, Ocucor Pistol and Kreska Ice Pick. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters, and the timed bundle-exclusive Bloodshed Sigil.
descriptions.zh: 这个大型组合包结合了迦楼罗组合包以及奥布山谷生存组合包。其包含迦楼罗战甲、噬蛇弩、迦楼罗巴托里头盔、金鹏背饰、武使之力步枪、视使之触手枪，以及直镐冰镐。同时也包含了 3 天经验值加成和星币加成以及限时组合包限定的血光纹章。

descriptions.en: Make their power yours with this Corpus-developed weapon collection. Includes the Exergis Shotgun, Plinx Revolver, Galvacord Whip and Flox Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 通过使用这个科普斯研发的武器组合包，将他们的力量化为己用。包括晶能放射器霰弹枪，漫射者左轮手枪，电流刺索鞭子和弗洛克斯背饰。

descriptions.en: This icy bundle contains the Frost Harka Skin and the Longsword Frysta Skin.
descriptions.zh: 这套冰凉的组合包包含了冰雪寒霜寒地牛怪外观和长剑凝冰外观

names.zh: 冰雪寒霜寒地牛怪组合包

descriptions.en: Get Frost and all his favorite gear.
descriptions.zh: 获得冰雪寒霜和他的御用装备。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Frost in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Frost Voidshell Skin and Cryosleeper material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含冰雪寒霜虚空之壳外观以及低温眠者材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 冰雪寒霜虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en: Streamlined decorative armor in the style of the Furis and Sybaris.

descriptions.en:
The Murmur continues to scrape deeper into our realm of existence. Having devised a solution to detect such whispers, Fibonacci won't allow such trespassing to threaten our system.

This Operation relies on Tenno across the Origin System to construct an invisible ‘living defense' against the growing Murmur threat. Players must have completed the Whispers in the Walls Quest to participate!

How to play:

To join this living defense, or ‘Murmur Telemetry Chorus,' you must hunt down the power source that'll continuously power your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle.

1. Go to your Dojo and build the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle from your Dojo Decorations. Only one Gargoyle can be built per Dojo, so if you don't see it in your Decoration list, your Clan Members may have already placed it!

2. Play Effervo on Deimos to earn Operation rewards. Players must successfully defeat both the Void Angel and the Assassination Target in-mission to earn one of the following:
  • Curse of Knowing (The Fragmented Suzerain)
  • Curse of Seeing (The Fragmented Anchorite)
  • Curse of Hearing (The Fragmented Zelator)

Earn 1 Curse per Normal Path mission, or double of the same Curse on Steel Path.

Successfully defeating the Assassination Target also rewards Grotesque Splinters. 

3. Return to your Dojo and feed the Curses to your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle every week to contribute to a Clan Trophy. Contribute Curses each week to hit the Cap and improve your Clan Scoring -- resulting in better Trophies at the end!

4. Visit the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle to exchange Grotesque Splinters for various Operation rewards!
descriptions.zh:
低语者继续深入侵蚀我们存在的领域。斐波那契已经设计出一种检测这些低语者的方法，决不允许这样的侵入威胁我们的星系。

这项行动需要始源星系中的天诺们共同建立一道看不见的"活跃的防御工事"，以应对日益增长的低语者威胁。玩家必须完成《墙中低语》系列任务才能参与！

如何游玩：

要加入这种活跃的防御工事，或称为"低语者遥测合声"，你需要找到可以为警戒形态合成兽像持续供能的能量源。

1. 前往道场并从道场装饰中建造警戒形态合成兽像。每个道场只能建造一尊合成兽像，如果你在装饰列表中看不到它，可能是你的氏族成员已经放置了它！

2. 在火卫二恶涌上游玩来获取行动奖励。玩家必须在任务中成功击败虚空天使和刺杀目标来获取以下物品之一：
  • 认知诅咒（接肢宗主）
  • 视觉诅咒（接肢隐士）
  • 听觉诅咒（接肢信徒）

每完成一次普通任务，可获得 1 个诅咒，或者在钢铁之路上获得两倍同样的诅咒。

成功击败刺杀目标还将奖励怪异碎片。 

3. 返回你的道场，每周向你的警戒形态合成兽像喂食诅咒，以助于氏族奖杯的贡献。每周贡献诅咒以达到上限，并提高氏族分数——从而在最后获得更好的奖杯！

4. 拜访警戒形态合成兽像，用怪异碎片换取各种行动奖励！

names.zh: 瓦尔基里传家宝组合包

descriptions.en: Refine the legacy of a genius tactician with this collection of bold Heirloom items.

descriptions.en: Helminth hungers to make you stronger. Welcome Helminth into your Orbiter with this bundle and you will be able to replace Warframe Abilities and Invigorate Warframes with temporary buffs.

descriptions.en: A collection of wobbly statuettes featuring the protoframes Arthur, Aoi, Amir, Eleanor, Lettie and Quincy.

descriptions.en:
Load up with Hildryn and several iconic additions for this stolid Warframe: the robust Surator Syandana, the intimidating Asuron Helmet and the distinctive Larkspur Archgun. Includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters as well as an Archgun Gravimag device.
NOTE: To deploy an Archgun equipped with a Gravimag, you will require an Archgun Deployer obtained from the Profit-Taker missions in Fortuna.
descriptions.zh:
装备上重装武神以及与这款高冷的战甲相关的标志性物品：稳固的雪瑞达背饰、威风的阿苏伦头盔以及独特的翠雀曲翼枪械。此组合包还包含了3天经验和星币加成以及曲翼枪械重力磁抵器。
请注意：为了装备配载了重力磁抵器的曲翼枪械，您需要从福尔图娜的利润收割者任务中获取一个曲翼枪械设置器。

descriptions.en: A collection of alternate styles for holstering and drawing a range of Melee Weapons.
descriptions.zh: 一套替换部分近战武器收起和拔出风格的收藏组合。

descriptions.en: Each Kaithe Coronet in the Steed’s Resolve Pack reflects a Duviri Mood Spiral. Express your Kaithe's moods just as Dominus Thrax expresses himself through Duviri's ever-changing sky.

descriptions.zh: 钙化的肉体创造出了怪异的美感。

descriptions.en: This collection of unnatural, malformed, Infested growths contains; the Caustacyst Scythe, the Embolist pistol, Tentacyst accessory for Melee Weapons and the Embolist armor.

descriptions.zh: 这种装饰性的护甲由感染者的硬壳制成并将其直接移植到使用者身上。

descriptions.en:
Boost your Arsenal instantly with the new Ember Starter Pack, including a Warframe, Customizations and many more powerful items. Light the Origin System aflame with Ember's Abilities and Essential Heat Damage Mods. Get the Ember Starter Pack and burn away the opposition today!

Pack Includes:
- Ember Warframe
- Ember Phoenix Helmet
- Nikana Weapon
- Essential Heat Damage Mod Bundle

One per account. Available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过全新的永恒烈焰入门组合包立即增强你的军械库，组合包内含一款战甲、自定义装饰，以及更多强力物品！用永恒烈焰的技能和基础火焰伤害振幅晶体来点燃整个始源星系。立即获取永恒烈焰入门组合包并将对手烧成灰烬！

组合包内含：
- 永恒烈焰战甲
- 永恒烈焰凤凰头盔
- 侍刃武器
- 火焰伤害振幅晶体基础组合包

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。

descriptions.en: Take aim with this striking collection of Ivara Skathi items. Includes the Ivara Skathi Skin, Dali Ballistica Skin and the Thiazi Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 穿戴好这套引人注目的神弓游侠冬之女神组合包中的装饰， 蓄势待发。组合包内含神弓游侠冬之女神外观，达利·布里斯提卡外观以及夏基背饰。

names.zh: 神弓游侠冬之女神组合包

descriptions.en:
Fight an eternal battle for the future with Vena, the blood-loving fanatic, and Ryoku, the cool and calculating killer. Two bitter rivals brought together in this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins. 

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh:
与嗜血狂热者维纳和冷静狡黠的杀手忍力一同，为未来展开一场永恒之战。这两位宿敌将在这组原型战甲双子外观中并肩作战。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

descriptions.en: What might have been becomes reality with Sirius & Orion. Assume the full might of dueling dark futures and follow the stars to constellations of combined power.
descriptions.zh: 在西里斯与奥里昂的交汇处，曾经的可能化为现实。感受两股黑暗未来交锋的磅礴之力，追随星辰，探寻众星的融合之力。

names.zh: 众星西里斯&奥里昂组合包

descriptions.en:
Show your Xbox One allegiance with the all-new Prestige Pack X!
Gear up with this exclusive set of Jade Axa Armor, the next-generation armor for your Warframe.

Prestige Pack X includes:
- Jade Axa Chest Plate
- Jade Axa Shoulder Plates
- Jade Axa Leg Plates
- 170 Platinum

This Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:

用这个专属的星际战甲次世代护甲套装－翡翠 AXA 护甲来武装自己。

荣耀威望包 X 内含：
- 翡翠 AXA 胸甲
- 翡翠 AXA 肩甲
- 翡翠 AXA 腿甲
- 170 白金

这个组合包在限定时间内每个账号仅限购买一次。

names.zh: 专属的荣耀威望包 X

descriptions.en: Crack the whip and release the Kavat with this vicious collection. Includes the Khora Warframe, Dual Keres swords, Hystrix quill gun, Kerata Syandana, and the Khora Delphi helmet.
descriptions.zh: 用这款凶恶的组合包来制造鞭击并释放出库娃。里面包括了荒野猎手战甲、凯瑞斯双刀、豪猪飞镖枪、聚集背饰、和荒野猎手德尔斐头盔。

descriptions.en:
Embody the galaxy’s most dangerous flora with the Urushu Collection. Includes the Khora Urushu Skin, the Veratria Blade and Whip Skin, the Pulchranopsis Syandana, and the Maculatia Skin for Venari or your other favorite Kavat.

Includes Khora Urushu Agile and Noble animation sets.
descriptions.zh:
漆花组合包涵盖了星系内最危险的植物。内含荒野猎手漆花外观、藜芦剑鞭外观，秀兰背饰，以及适用于薇娜丽或其他你喜欢的库娃的毒参外观。

内含荒野猎手漆花迅捷站姿和荒野猎手漆花尊贵站姿。

descriptions.en: Repaired with golden-alloys, these battle-scarred weapons have been transformed into objects of beauty. Contains skins for the Braton, Paris, Kunai, Lato, Aklato, Skana and Bo.
descriptions.zh: 利用金色合金修复后，这些战痕累累的武器已经转化为优美的物件。组合包中包含布莱顿、帕里斯、苦无、拉托、空刃和玻之武杖的外观。

descriptions.en: Provides basic masking options for a Kubrow's innate DNA structure, allowing coat color customization.
descriptions.zh: 提供给库狛的天生基因结构用的基础版遮蔽选项，让你能自定义库狛的颜色。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Doveran Kubrow ancestors.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具包含了改造库狛基因结构并使其毛皮花纹与其道维然祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

descriptions.zh: 这条獒犬既能承受打击，也能造成伤害。

descriptions.en: Euleria Entrati commissioned this unique Kubrow DNA segment to manifest a creature from the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
descriptions.zh: 欧拉瑞娅·英择谛定制了这个独特的库狛 DNA 模块来实体化《双衍王境故事集》中的一种生物。

descriptions.en: First silence, then the snapping of a twig, then death.
descriptions.zh: 先是寂静无声，后是树枝折断的声音，再后就是生命的消散。

descriptions.zh: 用这款毛皮花纹来培育一只足以赢得选美大奖的库狛和库娃吧。此组合包同时包含海诺库狛毛皮花纹和狄尔拉库娃毛皮花纹。[天诺之友比赛冠军]

descriptions.en: A full set of Kuva Armor.
descriptions.zh: 一整套赤毒护甲。

descriptions.en: Become Grineer royalty with this complete set of Kuva weapons and armor. Includes the Zarr cannon, Kesheg halberd, Twin Rogga pistols, as well as the fearsome Kuva Armor, Kuva Cloak and Kuva Cord. This bundle also features four Kuva landing craft skins and Kuva Kubrow and Kavat Armor.
descriptions.zh: 以这组赤毒武器和护甲组来效忠克隆尼。组合包内含沙皇火炮、怯薛长戟、双子罗格手枪，以及可怕的赤毒护甲、赤毒斗篷和赤毒绳结。同时附送四款赤毒登陆艇外观、库狛和库娃专用的赤毒护甲。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Start Anew Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 以万象更新组合包庆贺农历新年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Blessing & Fortune Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 以福禄双全组合包庆贺农历新年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Luminous Brilliance Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 以璀璨光华组合包庆贺农历新年。

descriptions.en: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. The contents of this bundle are imbued with peace and comfort.
descriptions.zh: 辞旧迎新！时尚地欢庆新年。愿这个组合包中的内容为你带来平安与健康。

descriptions.en: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. Good fortune is sure to come your way as you make use of the items in this bundle.
descriptions.zh: 辞旧迎新！时尚地庆祝新年。当你使用这个组合包中的物品时，好运就会降临。

descriptions.en: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. This bundle makes for a spectacular celebration.
descriptions.zh: 辞旧迎新！时尚地欢庆新年。让这个组合包为你带来一场盛大的庆典。

descriptions.en: Invite good fortune with the Chroma Zunlong Floof and Nukor Lunaeus Skin.
descriptions.zh: 让怒炎龙骑尊龙玩偶和努寇微波枪岁朝外观为你带来好运。

descriptions.en: Ring in prosperity with the Lunar Renewal UI theme, Dual Swords Lunaeus Skin, Baochun Sugatra, and Lunar Renewal Soar Sigil.
descriptions.zh: 用新春界面主题、双剑岁朝外观，报春坠饰以及新春龙翔纹章来迎接繁荣兴盛。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the year of the dragon with the Chroma Zunlong Skin and its complimentary Ephemera, Emote, Ogris Skin, Sentinel Skin, and Sentinel Armor.
descriptions.zh: 用怒炎龙骑尊龙外观以及其附赠的幻纹、表情动作、食人女魔外观、守护外观，和守护护甲来欢庆龙年。

descriptions.en: Prepare your Sentinel for a dance of Lunar Renewal revelry.
descriptions.zh: 装扮守护，共舞新春华章。

descriptions.en: Invite good fortune with the Lunar Renewal UI theme, Hespar Lunaeus Skin, Cordmade Sugatra, Mirage Nuwa Floof, and Lunar Renewal Snake Sigil.
descriptions.zh: 通过新春界面主题、暮斩岁朝外观、编绳坠饰、魅影精灵女娲玩偶以及新春腾蛇纹章，来祈求好运！

descriptions.en: Ring in prosperity with the Mirage Nuwa Skin and its complimentary Ephemera, Boltor Skin, Kavat Armor, and Floof.
descriptions.zh: 使用魅影精灵女娲外观及其配套的幻纹、螺钉步枪外观、库娃护甲和玩偶来喜迎蛇年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the year of the snake with everything in both the Smoky Quartz Bundle and the Pink Topaz Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 通过烟晶组合包和粉红托帕组合包中的所有物品来庆祝蛇年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Year of the Horse in style with this equine collection.
descriptions.zh: 用这款与午马有关的组合包欢庆新春。

descriptions.en: Kindle the ghostly light of wrath with the Dagath Yfari Collection. The sight of her spectral cavalry strikes fear into the hearts of those with ill intent.
descriptions.zh: 通过无面骑影炎灵组合包点燃愤怒的幽灵之光。她那幽灵般的骑兵，会让那些怀有恶意的人心生恐惧。

descriptions.en: This complete collection of Lunar Renewal skins and items is everything you need to rejoice in the turning of another year.
descriptions.zh: 这一整套新春外观与物品组合包，包含了庆祝新一年到来所需的全部物品。

descriptions.en: Get a taste of The Old Blood with this exclusive, one-time purchase, of Kuva Lich items. Includes a full set of Requiem Mods, the Radiant Requiem Relic Pack, Kuva Warframe Armor, and an assortment of Kuva Lich themed color pallets.
descriptions.zh: 通过这个关于赤毒玄骸物品的专属一次性购买来呷一口《远古之血》。包含有全套安魂振幅晶体、光辉安魂遗物组合包、赤毒战甲护甲以及各种赤毒玄骸主题调色盘。

descriptions.en:
The energy flowing within this sheath changes to match the blade within it. The Nikana will cause the energy to flow like the current of a river, while the Dragon Nikana causes the sheath to rage with molten fury.

This skin requires a Nikana or a Dragon Nikana to use.
descriptions.zh:
流动于刀鞘周围的能量会顺应武器的类型而改变。与「侍刃」一同装备时其刀鞘上的能量将如河水般流动，若与「龙之侍刃」一起装备则使刀鞘燃起炙烈的熔岩火花。

这项外观道具需要与「侍刃」或「龙之侍刃」搭配使用。

descriptions.en: Standing in the doorway between one world and another, be sure to cut a memorable figure. This bundle includes the Limina Limbo Skin, Tarock Thrown Weapon Skin, Interga Sugatra and the Sidereal Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 矗立于世界之间的出入口，务必得有一身让人难以忘怀的装扮。这款组合包内含灵薄狱阈限外观、投掷武器 塔罗外观、英特喀坠饰与恒星背饰。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Limbo in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Limbo Voidshell Skin and Lotus Pattern material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含灵薄狱虚空之壳外观以及莲之花纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 灵薄狱虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.zh: 一个内装有 25,000 星币和 1,000 内融核心的储藏箱。

descriptions.zh: 一个包含永世静态纹章，一个奥罗金反应堆和经验值加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Solar Flare Sigil, an Orokin Catalyst and a Credit Booster.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含烈阳之焰纹章，一个奥罗金催化剂和星币加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.zh: 一个包含莲的救援纹章，一个奥罗金反应堆和星币加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.zh: 内含光谱浪潮投影、一个奥罗金反应堆和 一个塑形块组合包的储藏箱

descriptions.en: Strike from the shadows with this collection of ill-gotten garb. Features the Loki Knave skin, Nari & Vali Skin for the Dual Kamas and Hulta armor set.

descriptions.en: Unlock Loki and his favorite gear.
descriptions.zh: 解锁邪神洛基和他的御用装备。

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.

descriptions.zh: 这套华丽的防护套装是由古代月动球竞赛中的冠军所穿戴。

descriptions.en: Make your enemies fear you as they fear the dark. This bundle includes accessories inspired by The Wild Hunt of Naberus.
descriptions.zh: 让敌人像害怕黑暗一样害怕你。此组合包内含受纳贝流士狂猎启发的配件。

descriptions.en: Breathe new life into Mag with this collection of signature items. Includes the lavish Mag Pneuma Skin, Maruta Tonfa Skin, and the Vasa Syandana.

descriptions.en:
Adorn Mag in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mag Voidshell Skin and Soma Waves material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含磁力虚空之壳外观以及胞体振波材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: A series 2 helmet for Excalibur, Frost, Loki, Rhino, Ash, Vauban, and Volt Warframes!
descriptions.zh: 圣剑、冰雪寒霜、邪神洛基、狂野犀牛、灰烬之刃、工程统帅和伏特战甲的第二系列头盔！

descriptions.zh: 一套投影组合包，取材自 MASHED 制作的《百日星际战甲》视频。

descriptions.en: Cast a shadow of pure menace.
descriptions.zh: 投下充斥着纯粹威慑的暗影。

descriptions.en: Succumb to the Infestation with the Nidus Warframe, Hema rifle, Hirudo fist-weapons, and the Thorac Syandana. Includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 通过异变之巢战甲、血肢步枪、 蚂蟥拳套武器，以及胸廓背饰来屈服在感染者面前吧。内含 3 天经验值加成和星币加成。

descriptions.en: Everything you need to become the ultimate terror. Includes the unholy Nidus Phryke Skin, Deimos Claw Skin, Nosos Syandana, Helminth Charger Metus Skin and Metus Kubrow Armor.
descriptions.zh: 这里有着成为终极恐惧所需的一切。包括了不洁的异变之巢恐惧神外观、德莫斯双爪外观、恶疾背饰、赫明斯异变疾冲者米图斯外观和米图斯库狛护甲。

names.zh: 异变之巢恐惧神组合包

descriptions.en:
Adorn Nidus in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Nidus Voidshell Skin and Petrified Isos material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含异变之巢虚空之壳外观以及石化修复凝液材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 异变之巢虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en: A collection of skins ripped from the weapons of the brutal Nightwatch Corps.
descriptions.zh: 来自残酷的夜巡者部队所使用武器外观的组合包。

descriptions.en: Two glyphs for your profile, featuring Caliban Orfeo and Protea Caladrius in action.
descriptions.zh: 两款个人档案投影，呈现卡利班奥菲欧与泊时灵械医官鸟的战斗姿态。

names.en: Tempestuous Time in Action Glyph Bundle
names.zh: 狂暴时刻战斗姿态投影组合包

descriptions.en: Augment your reality with these Cephalon-inspired cosmetics.
descriptions.zh: 用这些受中枢启发的装饰来增强你的真实性。

descriptions.en:
Get two Nintendo Switch-exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum and more with the Esteem Pack II! Includes: Twin Grakatas (Secondary Weapon), Twin Grakatas Opal Skin, Volt Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack II may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 II」获取两件 Nintendo Switch™ 专属外观、超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容！其中包括：双子葛拉卡达（副武器）、双子葛拉卡达蛋白石外观、伏特蛋白石外观、 3 天星币和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 II」。

descriptions.en:
Get two Nintendo Switch-exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum and more with the Esteem Pack III! Includes: Corinth (Primary Weapon), Corinth Opal Skin, Mag Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack III may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 III」获取两件 Nintendo Switch™ 专属外观、超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容！其中包括：科林斯（主武器）、科林斯蛋白石外观、磁力蛋白石外观、 3 天星币和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 III」。

descriptions.en:
Get two Nintendo Switch™ - exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum, and more with the Esteem Pack IV! Includes: Fragor (Melee Weapon), Fragor Opal Skin, Frost Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack IV may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 IV 」获取两件 Nintendo Switch™ 专属外观、超值折扣白金以及更多精采内容！其中包括：重击巨锤（近战武器）、重击巨锤蛋白石外观、冰雪寒霜蛋白石外观、 3 天星币和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 IV 」。

descriptions.en:
Get two Nintendo Switch-exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum and more with the Esteem Pack! Includes: Guandao (Melee Weapon), Guandao Opal Skin, Excalibur Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum 

The Esteem Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过「钦佩崇敬包」获取两件 Nintendo Switch™ 专属外观、超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容！其中包括：关刀（近战武器）、关刀蛋白石外观、圣剑蛋白石外观、 3 天星币和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包」。

descriptions.en:
Get two Nintendo Switch-exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum and more with the Esteem Pack II! Includes: Twin Grakatas (Secondary Weapon), Twin Grakatas Opal Skin, Volt Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack II may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 II」获取两件 Nintendo Switch™ 专属外观、超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容！其中包括：双子葛拉卡达（副武器）、双子葛拉卡达蛋白石外观、伏特蛋白石外观、 3 天星币和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 II」。

descriptions.en: Add to your collection with these Nora Night glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 将这些诺拉·奈特投影加入到你的收藏当中。

descriptions.en: Harness the reactive power of Nova Atomica. Features the Nova Atomica Skin, Alamos Sniper Skin, and Radia Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 驾驭超能新星原子姬的反应能量吧。这款组合包内含超能新星原子姬外观、阿拉莫斯狙击枪外观，以及乐光背饰。

names.zh: 超能新星原子姬组合包

descriptions.en: Embrace the power of a divine with the Nova Asuri Skin, becoming a many-armed warrior with each power cast. This enlightened bundle also features the Rashasi Polearm Skin for any polearm weapon, and the sacred Danavi Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 携超能新星阿修罗外观拥抱圣灵之力，每次释放能力时都将化身为一名千手战士。这套已被启迪的组合包含有罗刹长柄武器外观，以及神圣的檀那婆背饰。

names.zh: 超能新星阿修罗组合包

descriptions.en:
Adorn Nova in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Nova Voidshell Skin and Pearlescent Plastid material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含超能新星虚空之壳外观以及珠光质体材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 超能新星虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en: Take control with this decadent collection of deluxe Nyx gear. Featuring the Nyx Pasithea Skin, Nyx Enthra Syandana, and the Hecaton Shotgun Skin.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款颓废的冥河夜神华丽装备来占据主导吧。独具特色的冥河夜神幻觉女神外观、冥河夜神迷醉背饰和百臂巨人霰弹枪外观。

names.zh: 冥河夜神幻觉女神组合包

descriptions.en: This ancient bundle contains enigmatic skins for Oberon, Ack & Brunt and Paris.
descriptions.zh: 这个远古的组合包包含了为龙王奥伯，认知 & 冲击和帕里斯设计的神秘外观。

names.zh: 龙王奥伯精灵之王组合包

descriptions.en: Everything for a virtuoso performance: Octavia’s Maestra skin, Verismo Syandana and the Boltor Bravura Skin. Also includes the Horos Collection of synthetic mandachord notes: the score to war, with a danceable beat.
descriptions.zh: 所有的一切都是为了艺术大师的演奏：吟游歌者音乐名家外观、写实歌剧背饰以及螺钉步枪炫技外观。还包括了舞韵曼达和弦琴曲调：舞曲风格的战争配乐。

names.zh: 吟游歌者音乐名家组合包

descriptions.en: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked, it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Operator armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews. Fitted for the Operator and the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制的指挥官套服。适用于指挥官与漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Operator armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat. Fitted for the Operator and the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 指挥官套服的灵感源自那些必须在酷热条件下工作的索拉里斯人。适用于指挥官与漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind.
descriptions.zh: 受到年迈预言家们的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。

descriptions.en: A complete set of armor honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills.
descriptions.zh: 一套完整的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。

descriptions.en: Nora's got the goods for you lucky Dreamers with this stylish collection.
descriptions.zh: 诺拉通过这个时尚的组合包为你们这些幸运的梦回者准备了好物。

names.zh: 午夜电波指挥官组合包

descriptions.en: A complete set of armor, crafted with surety of purpose and clarity of vision.
descriptions.zh: 一套完整的护甲，以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。

descriptions.en: Armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
descriptions.zh: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

descriptions.en: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
descriptions.zh: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的护甲，专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

descriptions.en: Commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis with Dex suits for the Operator and Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 为指挥官和漂泊者准备的灵敏套服，以纪念第一位天诺战士从冷冻睡眠中醒来的周年纪念日。

names.zh: 指挥官和漂泊者灵敏套服

descriptions.en: Celebrate the hairstyles of 1999 and beyond with this assortment of looks for the Operator and Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 通过这一系列适合指挥官和漂泊者的发型来致敬 1999 年及之后的经典发型。

descriptions.en: The future might be doomed, but style doesn't have to be with this collection featuring Ryoku and Vena's hairstyles for the Operator and Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 未来或许注定黯淡，但造型不必遵从这些，本组合包内含忍力和维纳为指挥官和漂泊者设计的发型。

descriptions.en: Be in style whether the year ends in ‘99 or otherwise, with this collection of looks for the Operator and Drifter featuring the signature hairstyles of the 1999 Hex, Roundtable, and Devil’s Triad Protoframes.
descriptions.zh: 无论这一年是否以 1999 年结束，都能让你保持时尚，这套为指挥官和漂泊者设计的造型系列，以 1999 年六人组、老圆桌和恶魔三重奏原型战甲的标志性发型为特色。

descriptions.en: Adopt the gothic style of the Devil’s Triad with this assortment of hairstyles for the Drifter and Operator.
descriptions.zh: 为漂泊者和指挥官提供一系列哥特式发型，展现恶魔三重奏的风格。

descriptions.en: Never let a bad hair day get in the way of fighting Scaldra with this assortment of hairstyles for the Operator and Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 有了这一系列适合指挥官和漂泊者的发型，再也不会因为糟糕的发型而妨碍你与炽蛇军的战斗。

descriptions.en: Everybody will know your name with this assortment of looks for the Operator and Drifter, featuring familiar hairstyles from the regulars of the Round Table Pub.
descriptions.zh: 有了这套指挥官和漂泊者的造型，每个人都会知道你的名字，以老圆桌酒吧常客们熟悉的发型为特色。

descriptions.en: You’re only as good as your last haircut - make it a great one with this ultimate collection of looks for the Operator and Drifter featuring all standard hairstyles.
descriptions.zh: 你的形象取决于你最近一次的发型——通过这套为指挥官和漂泊者准备的终极造型组合包，打造一个完美的发型，其中包含所有标准发型。

descriptions.en:
A bundle of multiple Vignettes used to decorate your Personal Quarters.

Also includes 14 Warframe Articula.
descriptions.zh:
一份装有多组装饰景观的组合包，可用于装饰个人房间。

同时包含 14 组战甲可动式模型。

descriptions.en: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
descriptions.zh: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

descriptions.en: Contains the complete uniform matching the Manduka Suit.
descriptions.zh: 包含了完整一套的 曼杜卡套装。

descriptions.en: This blood-red battledress embodies the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury. Fitted for both Drifter and Operator.
descriptions.zh: 这件血红色的战斗服完美体现了奥罗金的极致风格和奢华。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Become like Arlo’s devoted with this Operator cosmetics collection. Includes the Emissary Suit, Emissary Greaves, Emissary Hood, and Emissary Sleeves.
descriptions.zh: 用这套指挥官装饰来装扮成 Arlo 的信徒。内含使徒套装，使徒绑腿，使徒头罩和使徒袖件。

descriptions.en: TennoCon 2022 Operator & Drifter Suit Bundle
descriptions.zh: TennoCon 2022 指挥官 & 漂泊者套服组合包

names.zh: TennoCon 2022 指挥官 & 漂泊者套服组合包

descriptions.en: Operator Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
descriptions.zh: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制。

descriptions.en: Slide into this biker attire of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 凯恩壳原子摩托车礼服

descriptions.en: Armor modeled on the K-drive gear favored by Boon, leader of the canny and cunning Kubrodon Ventkids.
descriptions.zh: 依谨慎又灵巧的库狛顿领导人阿布最喜爱的 K 式悬浮板装备所仿制的护甲。

descriptions.en: The latest in Operator attire, featuring the voguish Koppra outfit and the unconventional Varida outfit.
descriptions.zh: 最新的指挥官盛装，包括了时尚的珂普拉外套和标新立异的瓦里达外套。

descriptions.en: Howl all you want with this collection of Umbra themed Operator gear. This collection includes the Umbra Hooded Scarf, Umbra Blindfold, Umbra Diadem, and Umbra Earpiece.
descriptions.zh: 以这组暗影主题的指挥官装备尽情嚎叫吧。这个组合包包括了，暗影连帽围巾、暗影眼罩、暗影头冠和暗影耳饰。
护甲套装上闪耀着绚丽的火焰光芒，定会令你目不转睛。

descriptions.en: The chitinous spines of Oraxia’s armor lend a menacing aspect to any Tenno.
descriptions.zh: 缚影蛛后护甲上的甲壳尖刺为所有天诺增添了威胁气息。

descriptions.en: This bundle contains an assortment of displays to decorate your orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 这个组合包内含有一系列用以装饰飞船的展示图。

descriptions.en: Forged by masters from the Tekelu School of weaponsmiths, these skins feature intricate designs of an unmatched quality.
descriptions.zh: 由提奇鲁宗派的武器工匠大师们所铸造，这套华丽的外观有着品质无与伦比的复杂设计。

descriptions.en: A collection of Mods that enhance <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage.
descriptions.zh: 收集了一系列强化<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害的振幅晶体。

names.zh: 摧毁传送门振幅晶体包

descriptions.en: A collection of fine Ostron rugs.
descriptions.zh: 精美的奥斯唐小地毯收藏组合。

names.zh: 奥斯唐小地毯收藏组合

descriptions.en: A distinctive collection of Orbiter adornments celebrating the industry of Cetus.
descriptions.zh: 一套别具特色的轨道飞行器装饰物，赞颂了希图斯的工业实力。

descriptions.en: A beautiful collection of Orbiter adornments made by Ostron craftspeople.
descriptions.zh: 这组精美的轨道飞行器装饰物是由希图斯的工匠打造。

descriptions.en:
Unleash the power of the Infestation with this exclusive PlayStationⓇ-exclusive pack! Wield the infectious Hema rifle and customize your Warframe or Orbiter with pustulous Customizations. 

This pack includes:

- Mucusk Syandana
- Hema
- Domestik Carrion Drone
- Infested Color Palette
- 170 Platinum

Claim your pack now and evolve your style in Warframe.

This pack is free to PlayStationⓇ Plus members and may only be redeemed once per account. Available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过这款 PlayStationⓇ 专属组合包释放感染者的力量！手持传染性极强的血肢步枪，并使用各种脓疱自定义装饰来装点你的战甲或轨道飞行器。此组合包内含：

- 黏液背饰
- 血肢
- 腐肉内务无人机
-异变体调色盘
- 170 白金立即领取你的组合包，在《星际战甲》中使你的风格更进一步。本组合包限时发售，拥有 PlayStationⓇ Plus 会员即可免费获得，每个账号只能领取一次。

descriptions.en:
Unleash your inner Grakata enthusiast with a cache of Clem-approved gear.

The Unstoppable Clem Pack includes:

- Twin Grakatas
- Udyat Syandana
- Noggle Statue - Clem
- 7 Day Credit Booster 
- Grineer Color Palette
- 170 Platinum

Claim your pack now. This pack is free to PlayStation® Plus members and may only be redeemed once per account. Available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
用克里姆认可的装备，释放你内心的葛短握柄达狂热。

无敌克里姆组合包内含：

- 双子葛短握柄达
- 乌加特背饰
- 克里姆摇头娃娃
- 7 天星币加成
- 克隆尼调色盘
- 170 白金

立即获取组合包！Playstation Plus 会员可免费获得，每个账号仅可领取一次。限时供应。

descriptions.en:
Harness the Grineer's militaristic ingenuity with this PlayStation-exclusive pack! Wield the ferocious Quatz Pistol and adorn your Warframe in the intricate metallic sheens of the Galvanik Armor.
 
This pack includes:
Galvanik Shoulder Plates
Galvanik Chest Plate
Galvanik Leg Plates
Amphor Syandana
Grineer (Color Palette)
Quatz Pistol
170 Platinum (Free Platinum)

Claim your pack now and evolve your style in Warframe. This pack is free to PlayStation Plus members and may only be redeemed once per account. Available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
这款 PlayStation 专属组合包助你驾驭克隆尼的军事智慧！挥舞凶悍的夸兹手枪，让你的战甲披上电激护甲的精密金属光泽。

此组合包内含：
电激肩甲
电激胸甲
电激腿甲
双耳背饰
克隆尼（调色盘）
夸兹手枪
170 白金（免费白金）

立即领取你的组合包，在《星际战甲》中使你的风格更进一步。本组合包限时发售，拥有 PlayStation Plus 会员即可免费获得，每个账号只能领取一次。

descriptions.en:
Elevate your Fashion Frame with this PlayStation® exclusive pack! Harness devastating Old War tech with the Quellor Rifle and adorn your Warframe in the cold metallic sheens of the Sigma Series Armor.

This pack includes:

- Sigma Series Chest Armor
- Sigma Series Shoulder Plate
- Sigma Series Leg Plate
- Quellor Rifle
- Orokin Reactor
- Orokin Catalyst
- Tenno (Color Palette)
- 170 Platinum

descriptions.en:
Konzu has a problem, a massive Infested Boil has broken through Earth's atmosphere, crashing down outside Cetus. As the boil grows, it spawns rabid Infested putting all life on the plains in jeopardy.

How to play:

Visit Konzu and initiate the Plague Star bounty
1. Head out onto the plains and find a Toxin Canister hidden within one of the Grineer caves
2. Take the canister to a mixing machine and defend the machine while it mixes 
3. Deposit the mixed toxin into a drone
4. Escort the drone to the boil
5. Kill off the Infested released from the boil. 

The Toxin can be augmented in two ways:
1. Eidolon Phylaxis can be created from a blueprint purchased from Nakak, and increases toxin lethality
2. Infested Catalyst is made in the Bio Lab in your clan's dojo, and causes the boil to spawn a massive Hemocyte

You must have Eidolon Phylaxis and Infested Catalyst in your inventory to run the Advanced and Steel Path Bounties.
descriptions.zh:
孔尊遇到了麻烦，一个巨大的感染疖瘤突破了地球的大气层，坠落在希图斯外。随着疖瘤的生长，它产生了狂暴的感染者怪物，使得平野上的生命受到了严重威胁。

如何行动：

造访孔尊并开始异变之星赏金任务
1. 前往平野并找到一个埋藏在克隆尼把守的洞穴中的毒素罐
2. 携带着毒素罐前往混合器，并在毒素进行混合时防守机器
3. 将混合后的毒素放在一架无人机上
4. 护送无人机前往疖瘤
5. 消灭疖瘤释放出来的感染者

毒素有 2 种方式增强：
1. 夜灵抗体可以通过娜卡处买来的设计图进行制作，可以增加毒素的杀伤力
2. 异变催化剂可以通过氏族道场的生物实验室进行制造，可以诱使疖瘤创造一个巨型的免疫血胞体

你的仓库中必须同时拥有夜灵抗体和异变催化剂才能进行进阶赏金任务和钢铁之路赏金任务。

在货币及物品上获得超赞的优惠，包含 3 天加成器、300 白金，及更多道具！

- 300 白金：白金是星际战甲世界中的高级货币。用它来购买星际战甲战甲、武器、装饰物品，及更多道具
- 3 天经验加成和资源数量加成：以双倍率升级武器及收集制造材料
- 苍鹰振幅晶体包：获得 5 张随机的振幅晶体
- 简化振幅晶体：增加一个星际战甲战甲的技能效率
- 奥罗金催化剂：武器的振幅晶体容量增加一倍
- 奥罗金反应堆：星际战甲战甲的振幅晶体容量增加一倍
- 珮菈背饰：用这款燃烧般的背饰装饰物品来自定义你的星际战甲战甲
- Nava 投影和纹章：用这款精致的投影和纹章向莲表示敬意

descriptions.en:
Pull off the perfect sneak attack with this Archwing gear.

It includes the Itzal Archwing, perfect for covert operations, and comes outfitted with the Centaur blade and guard, and the Fluctus crossbow.
descriptions.zh:
以这套曲翼装备完美地达成艰难的偷袭行动。

本包装内含刺影曲翼，非常适合用于隐蔽行动，并配有半人马剑盾与巨浪弩炮。

descriptions.en: The best gear for eliminating your enemies silently
descriptions.zh: 为暗杀准备的特别套装

descriptions.en: The accouterments of an experienced warrior. This collection includes the Styanax Synmora Helmet, Styanax Agogean Helmet, Lanex Syandana, Styanax Voidshell Skin with Fieldron Form material structure, and Tharros & Axios Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 一位经验丰富的勇士的精美装备。这款组合包内含无畏斗士步兵团头盔、无畏斗士极训头盔、阵兵背饰、无畏斗士虚空之壳外观和电磁力场装置形式材质结构以及豪勇 & 崇敬装饰。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Styanax in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Styanax Voidshell Skin and Fieldron Form material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含无畏斗士虚空之壳外观以及电磁力场装置形式材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 无畏斗士虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en: A sizzling collection of skins for the Zarr, Twin Rogga, Kesheg and Centuria Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 沙皇、双子罗格、怯薛、百人背饰的酷热外观组合包。

descriptions.en: A sizzling collection of skins for the Quartakk, Stubba, a set of Maggor Towsun Armor and a Maggor Towsun Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 为夸塔克，史度巴，夏至玛戈护甲与夏至玛戈背饰所准备的一系列热浪组合包。

descriptions.en: A set of Maggor Armor that has been adorned with a sizzling design.
descriptions.zh: 一整套装饰着酷热造型的玛戈护甲。

descriptions.en: Guide your style with this complete Lodestar armor set.
descriptions.zh: 用这完整的一套北极星护甲来指引你的风格。

descriptions.en: A cache packed full of Darvo's finest wares, including a 7-day Affinity Booster, 7-day Credit Booster, a Forma, an Orokin Reactor, an Orokin Catalyst.
descriptions.zh: 一个塞满达尔沃最好商品的组合包，其中包含了一款 7 天经验值加成，一款 7 天奖金加成器，一个塑形块，一个奥罗金反应堆，一个奥罗金催化剂，一个战甲槽位和一个武器槽位。

descriptions.en: This bundle features the Soma assault rifle, Dual Raza battle hachets and Aksomati pistols. Sharing a unique visual style, the weapons in this set will inspire awe in your allies and fear in your foes.
descriptions.zh: 这个组合包中包含月神突击步枪，锋月双斧和轻灵月神双枪。分享独特的风格，这个组合包中的武器在使你的盟友敬畏的同时也让你的敌人畏惧。

descriptions.en: An armor set traditionally worn by those entrusted with the duties of Arbitration according to the Precepts of Hexis.
descriptions.zh: 由依据均衡仲裁者戒律被委以仲裁职责的人所穿的传统护甲。

descriptions.en: From knowledge: creation. An armor set forged to exacting Precepts.
descriptions.zh: 知识为创造之母。一套由特定枢律锻造的护甲。

descriptions.en: Orchid patterns and flowing organic lines are signature to New Lokan armor.
descriptions.zh: 兰花图案和流畅的有机线条是新世间护甲的标志。

descriptions.en: An Ostron armor set crafted from Orokin tower salvage.
descriptions.zh: 由奥罗金塔残骸打造而成的奥斯唐护甲套装。

descriptions.en: The armor of the Perrin Sequence is clean and economically designed.
descriptions.zh: 佩兰数列的护甲在设计上简洁而又节俭。

descriptions.en: Lightweight and unobtrusive. The armor of Red Veil assassins.
descriptions.zh: 轻盈且又低调。血色面纱刺客的护甲。

descriptions.en: Pieced together from salvage, this ad hoc armor set is signature to the Grineer renegades of Steel Meridian.
descriptions.zh: 这套特别的护甲由残骸拼接打造而成，是钢铁防线克隆尼反叛者的标志性护甲。

descriptions.en: Repurposed and reliable, strap on Solaris armor and everything's green.
descriptions.zh: 可靠且经过改造，穿上索拉里斯护甲，你就能一路畅通无阻。

descriptions.en: Contains 200 Vosfor, which may be traded with Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica for Arcanes.
descriptions.zh: 内含 200 个荧尘，可以用于在解剖圣所与洛德交换赋能。

descriptions.en: A four-panel, poster series celebrating the cinematic quests of Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 庆祝《星际战甲》电影式系列任务的四幅系列海报。

descriptions.en: Recall the New War with cosmetics that invoke Narmer and Archons.
descriptions.zh: 通过那些唤起合一众和执刑官的自定义装饰来回忆新纪之战。

descriptions.en:
UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL TO FIGHT THE NEW WAR!

For a limited time, instantly add a Weapon, Customizations, Boosters and more to your Arsenal to repel the Sentient invasion and fight The New War. Evolve your look with the new Protovyre Ephemera, which will unlock additional Customizations as you play.

Pack Includes:
- Protovyre Ephemera
- Redeemer
- Ravurex Gunblade Skin*
- Narmer Color Palette*
- 7-Day Affinity Booster
- 7-Day Credit Booster
- Archon Nira Glyph*
- Archon Nira Sigil*

One per account. Items marked with * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
升级你的军械库来应对《新纪之战》！

在限定的时间内，即刻把一件武器、自定义装饰、加成，以及更多精彩物品添加到你的军械库，以击退灵煞的入侵，并应对《新纪之战》。使用全新的源噬装备升级你的外观，该物品将在你游玩时解锁额外的自定义装饰。

- 源噬幻纹
- 救赎者
- 掠骨枪刃外观*

- 执刑官混沌蛇主投影*

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 "*" 的物品仅能在限定时间内，通过这个组合包获取。
