descriptions.en: A bundle containing displays of Marie, Lyon, and Roathe. Together, they form the Devil's Triad.
descriptions.zh: 包含玛丽、里昂和罗瑟展示图的组合包。三者共同构成恶魔三重奏。

descriptions.en: Honor the Tenno legacy with this finely crafted set of training armor, as worn during the annual Origin System ceremonial games.
descriptions.zh: 通过这件精心打造的训练护甲来纪念天诺的传统，就像一年一度的始源星系庆典中穿戴的那样。

descriptions.en:
A Voidtongue cry, trapped in the stone. Crucial to unraveling the secrets of the Murmur.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
被封印在石头里的虚空语叫声，对解开低语者的秘密至关重要。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
The deepest of Voidtongue moans, etched into stone. An unlikely asset in the construction of Albrecht's vessels.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
被刻进石头中的深沉的虚空语哀鸣。意外地成为了一种建造阿尔布雷希特的承载体的资源。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
The quietest and most elusive of Voidtongue utterances. Sought after but never found by Albrecht.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
虚空语中最安静、最难以捉摸的话语。阿尔布雷希特一直在寻找却从未找到。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
Barbed and half-real, shed by a Void Angel.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
带刺且半真实，从一位虚空天使脱落。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A metallic plume from a Void Angel's wing.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
虚空天使翅膀上的一片金属羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
The fine plumes from a Void Angel's crown.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
虚空天使王冠上的精美羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A symbol of genius, fallen from Void Angels long ago.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
天才的象征，很久以前就从虚空天使身上掉落了。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A Void Angel's living feather, ripped out in combat.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
一根来自虚空天使的鲜活羽毛，在战斗中被扯了下来。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en: Enjoy an eclectic variety of expressive designs. The Multiform Visage Ink Bundle includes Gneissic Visage Ink and all the designs from the Cloned Flesh, Taxmen, and Devotion Visage Ink Collections. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 享受不拘一格且富有表现力的样式。多样面部纹身墨水组合包内含漂泊者的片麻岩面部纹身墨水，以及来自复制肉体、税务官，挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包中的所有面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 多样面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Invest in self-expression. The Taxmen Visage Ink Collection includes Airlock, Collateral, Dividend, Futures, and Hull Breach Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 投资于自我表达。税务官面部纹身墨水组合包包含气闸、抵押、红利、期货和船裂面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 税务官面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en:
The Tales of Duviri storybook finds expression in these designs. The Paradox Visage Ink Collection includes Sharpshooter, Heavy Striker, Manipura, and Aru Visage Ink.
*Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh:
《双衍王境故事集》中的故事在这些设计中得到了体现。悖论面部纹身墨水组合包内含神射手、猛力重击者、宝石和存在面部纹身墨水。
*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 悖论面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en:
Embrace the spirit of discovery. The Curiosity Visage Ink Collection includes Academe, Circuit, Kiai, and Verula Ink designs.
*Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh:
拥抱探索精神。好奇心面部纹身墨水组合包内含学院、无尽回廊、气合和维鲁拉面部纹身图案。
*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 好奇心面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Set yourself apart. The Cloned Flesh Visage Ink Collection includes Bulwark, Exome, Helix, Hunter, and Siege Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 让自己与众不同。复制肉体面部纹身墨水组合包包括堡垒、外显子、螺旋、猎人和攻城面部纹身图案。 *面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 复制肉体面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Wear your heart on your sleeve. The Devotion Visage Ink Collection includes Affections, Amorous, Cherub, and Eros Struck Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 敞开你的心扉。挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包包括爱意、风情之花、小天使和爱神秋波面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Take up the distinctive arms of the Dax of Tau with this collection of weapon skins.
descriptions.zh: 通过这套武器外观，体验陶星系禁卫的独特武器。

names.zh: 陶星系禁卫军备外观组合包

descriptions.en:
Deepen the bonds of camaraderie between the three unlikely companions of the Devil's Triad with this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh: 通过这组原型战甲双子外观，加深恶魔三重奏中三位看似不可能的伙伴之间的友谊。

descriptions.en: Forged by masters from the Tekelu School of weaponsmiths, these skins feature intricate designs of an unmatched quality.
descriptions.zh: 由提奇鲁宗派的武器工匠大师们所铸造，这套华丽的外观有着品质无与伦比的复杂设计。

names.zh: 提奇鲁外观组合包 II

descriptions.en: Forged by masters from the Tekelu School of weaponsmiths, these skins feature intricate designs of an unmatched quality.
descriptions.zh: 由提奇鲁宗派的武器工匠大师们所铸造，这套华丽的外观有着品质无与伦比的复杂设计。

names.zh: 提奇鲁外观组合包 III

descriptions.en:
Discover a gruesome new playstyle with the Tempestarii Supporter Pack! This pack has everything you need to awaken your inner shadow, including discounted Platinum and more.

- 350 Platinum
- Sevagoth Warframe
- Vithil Syandana
- Lucifuge Helmet
- 30-Day Affinity Booster
- Forma Bundle

Limited-time offer. Only one per account.
descriptions.zh:
通过风暴使者支援包来探索令人毛骨悚然的全新玩法！这个组合包拥有让你的内在阴影觉醒所需要的一切，包括超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容。

- 350 白金
- 虚冥鬼影战甲
- 威丝背饰
- 避光头盔
- 30 天经验值加成
- 塑形块组合包

限时发售。每个账号仅限购买一次。

descriptions.en: An anniversary-themed collection featuring a Glyph and two Displays made by community artists to celebrate 10 Years of Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 一个周年纪念主题的组合包，内含一个投影和两个由社区艺术家制作的展示图，以此庆祝星际战甲的十周年纪念。

names.zh: 十周年玩家社区艺术品组合包

descriptions.en: Enjoy Update 12 in style. This pack features the latest items, including the Zephyr Warframe and the deadly new weapons: Phage, Akstiletto and Jat Kittag. Rapidly level your new gear with the included 3-Day Experience and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 体验高大上的更新 12 吧。这个更新包的特色是最新的装备，包括狂啸西风战甲和致命的新武器：噬菌者，史提托双枪和喷射战锤。为期三天的经验和星币加成让你迅速的升级你的新装备。

descriptions.en: Three colorful silken capes inspired by nature.
descriptions.zh: 三种受大自然启迪的丝质背饰。

descriptions.en: This collection of artful Tenno items includes the Endura rapier, Broca Syandana and the Nidina Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 这款玲珑的天诺物品组合包中包含三叶坚韧细剑、布洛卡背饰和尼迪纳护甲套装。

descriptions.en: This bundle contains the deadly Okina sais and the Spinning Needle stance.
descriptions.zh: 这个组合包内有致命的十手「三叉刺」，以及架式「旋压针刺」。

descriptions.en: TennoCon 2019 Armor Bundle
descriptions.zh: TennoCon 2019 护甲套装

descriptions.en:
Now’s your chance to get the exclusive TennoCon 2019 Armor Set, Sigil, and much more! The TennoCon 2019 Digital Pack is now available!

The Warframe®: TennoCon 2019 Digital Pack Includes:
- TennoCon 2019 Armor Set
- TennoCon 2019 Sigil
- TennoCon 2019 Display Art
- TennoCon 2019 Glyph
- TennoCon 2019 Emote
- 475 Platinum

Only available during TennoCon, from July 6 at 11 a.m. ET - July 13 at 11 a.m. ET:
- TennoCon 2019 Baro Relay Ticket

The Baro Relay Ticket offers exclusive access to purchase rare items, including everything Baro has ever sold!

descriptions.en:
Claim first blood with the Unreal Tournament Weapon Bundle!

Get three iconic Unreal Tournament Weapon Skins for the Flak Cannon, Rocket Launcher and Shock Rifle, three Weapons and more!

Unreal Tournament Weapon Bundle features:
- 250 Platinum
- Drakgoon Flak Cannon Skin
- Ogris Rocket Launcher Skin
- Stahlta Shock Rifle Skin
- Drakgoon Weapon and Weapon Slot
- Ogris Weapon and Weapon Slot
- Stahlta Weapon and Weapon Slot
- Essential Critical Chance Mod Bundle
- 7-Day Affinity Booster
descriptions.zh:
通过虚幻竞技场武器组合包来拿下第一滴血！

获取三件标志性的高射加农炮、火箭发射器和冲击步枪虚幻竞技场武外观、三种武器，以及更多精彩内容！

虚幻竞技场武器组合包内含：
- 250 白金
- 龙骑兵 高射加农炮外观
- 食人女魔 火箭发射器外观
- 钢刃步枪 冲击步枪外观
- 龙骑兵武器和武器槽位
- 食人女魔武器和武器槽
- 钢刃步枪武器和武器槽
- 暴击几率圣装基础组合包
- 7 天经验值加成

names.zh: 《星际战甲》®：虚幻竞技场武器组合包

descriptions.en: This bundle features some of the deadliest items from Update 10, including the Nekros Warframe and the Carrier Sentinel, both courtesy of the Design Council. Also included is Soma, the new Tenno Assault Rifle and an Ether Reaper, the perfect companion blade for your Nekros Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 这个综合包采用了最新奥罗金技术，包括御魂主宰战甲和委员会设计的哨兵 - 搬运者。此综合包还包括天诺战士用月神突击步枪，以及御魂主宰战甲的完美搭档——苍穹死神。

descriptions.en:
Find all the latest cosmetic accessories for Update 12, bundled in this pack! 

It contains Immortal Skins for Vauban, Saryn, Volt and Nova Warframes, Zephyr Cierzo Helmet and Oberon Oryx Helmet.
descriptions.zh:
从这个组合包中找到最新的装饰配件吧！

内含工程统帅、剧毒之触、伏特和超能新星战甲的不朽外观，以及狂啸西风战甲西熟风头盔以及龙王奥伯战甲羚羊头盔。

descriptions.en:
Start playing with the Mirage Warframe, Silva & Aegis sword and shield set and Akzani pistols with this bundle! Includes the 'Eleventh Storm' Stance Mod and Credit and Affinity Boosters to accelerate your gaming experience. 

Also includes a fully crafted 'Hidden Messages' quest key, giving you instant access to experiencing the lore behind Mirage!
descriptions.zh:
通过这个组合包中的魅影精灵战甲，剑盾组合席瓦 & 神盾还有荒谬双枪一起同乐吧！内含终焉风暴架式振幅晶体以及星币和经验值加成道具来加速您的游戏体验。

同时也包含了制造完成的《被隐藏的信息》任务钥匙，让你能马上体验隐藏在幻影战甲背后的传说。

descriptions.en: Start playing with the Limbo Warframe, Opticor laser cannon and the Halikar throwing mace with this bundle! Includes Credit and Affinity Boosters to accelerate your gaming experience.

通过这套古老的纪念品唤起尘封已久的战场记忆。有些事永远不应被遗忘。

克莱布里克支架、格兰姆棱镜和洛林曲柄均为增幅器部件，可以在希图斯的夜羽洞穴内进行组装。

descriptions.en: Seize fractal power. This pack includes the Citrine Warframe, Steflos and Corufell weapons, Citrine Sigil, Alumeti Sugatra, Citrine Kalite Helmet, and the Belric and Rania Reunited Ship Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 掌控分形的力量。这个组合包内含辉光晶灵战甲、石晶之花和闪劫武器、辉光晶灵纹章、矾茂坠饰、辉光晶灵盐烁头盔，以及贝里克与拉尼娅团聚飞船装饰。

descriptions.en: Take aim as the sharpshooter Warframe, Cyte-09, along with his signature Weapons and Customizations.
descriptions.zh:
以神枪手的身份瞄准目标，并配备其标志性武器和自定义装饰。

此组合包内含：
- 九 战甲
- 神枪手荣光头盔
- 侦察者步枪
- 神枪手投影
- 靶心纹章
- 3 天经验值加成
- 流逝遗迹装饰

每个账号只能购买该组合包一次。

descriptions.en: Gaze into the mirror that accuses. This collection includes the Dagath Warframe, her Dorrclave weapon, the Dagath Ganceann Helmet, and Aumen Kaithe Gear.
descriptions.zh: 凝视控诉之镜。该组合包内含无面骑影战甲、她的怒斩武器、无面骑影无首头盔，以及金兆绝灵骥装备。

descriptions.en: Write a new chapter for the keeper of history. His collection includes the Dante Warframe, Dante Cantist Helmet, Rencowl Syandana, Oranist Armor, Ruvox Melee Weapon, and Noctua's Paragrimm Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 为历史的守护者谱写新的篇章。他的组合包内含缮写士战甲、缮写士撰诗者头盔、富思背饰、奥哲护甲、古声近战武器以及夜枭的幽幽鹰装饰。

descriptions.en: Make art your weapon, with the shadowgrapher Follie
descriptions.zh: 通过绘影者狂墨将艺术与你的武器完美融合。

descriptions.en: The conductive path to Gyre’s core. This collection includes the Gyre Warframe, Gyre Automaton Helmet, Alternox Rifle, Triodic Syandana, and Gyratory Sphere Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通往电光舞者核心的传导之路。该组合包内含电光舞者战甲、电光舞者姬械头盔、电幻步枪、三重背饰，以及回旋球装饰。

descriptions.en: Life and death meet in Jade. Her collection includes the Jade Warframe, Jade Aureolt Helmet, Motetique Signa, Harmony scythe, Cantare throwing blades, Evensong bow, and Jade Ophanim Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 生与死在圣天使身上交汇。她的组合包内含圣天使战甲、圣天使圣环头盔、圣歌头环、和谐镰刀、歌颂投掷刀刃、晚祷弓箭，和圣天使座天使装饰。

descriptions.en: Seize your destiny with the dice-maiden. Her collection includes the Koumei Warframe, her Orihime Helmet, Amanata, Higasa weapons, Buyoh and Rolling Fates Emotes, the Koumei Ito Glyph and Sigil, and the Koumei Engimono Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通过掷骰巫女掌握自己的命运。她的组合包内含御命织姬战甲、女织头盔、天薙刀、晴日伞武器、神乐舞和命运掷骰表情动作、御命织姬提线投影和纹章，以及御命织姬祈运坛装饰。
化身为冬日风暴之灵。舞霜剑姬锋利的细剑在呼啸的暴风雪之中舞动，剑气冲霄，即带来庇护，也带来毁灭。

descriptions.en: Grow strong with Nokko, brave defender of the Deepmines.
descriptions.zh: 与深矿的勇敢捍卫者蘑菇小子一起成长。

descriptions.en: Stalk your prey through the floating islands of Duviri with the new Oraxia Bundle! Featuring the deadly hunter Oraxia, as well as her signature Weapons and Customizations.
descriptions.zh: 通过全新的缚影蛛后组合包，在双衍王境的漂浮岛屿上追踪你的猎物！内含致命猎手缚影蛛后，以及她的标志性武器和自定义装饰。

descriptions.en: Command the wrath of Kullervo. His collection includes the Kullervo Warframe, Kullervo Usvah Helmet, Ahlto Syandana, and Rauta Shotgun.
descriptions.zh: 掌控刀锋囚徒的愤怒。组合包内含刀锋囚徒战甲、刀锋囚徒幽雾头盔、幽浪背饰以及锐铁霰弹枪。

descriptions.en: Summon a guardian with the strength to face Albrecht’s Laboratories. This collection includes the Qorvex Warframe, Qorvex Raxpart Helmet, Portcull Syandana, and Mandonel Archgun.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一位有实力面对阿尔布雷希特实验室的守护者。该组合包内含辐能堡垒战甲、辐能堡垒壁垒头盔、吊闸背饰和辐光弩炮曲翼枪械。

descriptions.en: Adapt to overcome any threat with Caliban, the perfect fusion of Sentient and Warframe capabilities. This collection includes the Caliban Warframe, the Caliban Cranion Helmet, Venato scythe, Neurovyre Syandana and Sporavyre Sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 灵煞和战甲功能的完美融合，用卡利班适应并克服任何威胁。该组合包内含卡利班战甲、卡利班锐颅头盔、脉纹镰刀、灵噬背饰和孢噬坠饰。

descriptions.en: Never let the music be silenced with Temple.
descriptions.zh: 永远不要让赤焰狂歌的音乐沉寂。

descriptions.en: Call down brimstone-laced devastation and take command of demonic servitors with Uriel, the Heretic of Xata.
descriptions.zh: 与真理的异端者炼狱使徒一起，召唤硫磺带来的毁灭性灾难，并指挥恶魔的仆从。

descriptions.en: Revere the relentless hunting shadow. This pack includes the Voruna Warframe, Sarofang and Perigale weapons, Voruna's Anukas Helmet and Voidshell Skin with Rough Cryotic material structure, the Okuri Tails Ephemera, and the Lua's Pack Mural.
descriptions.zh: 敬畏无情的暗影猎手。该组合包内含：赤影狼母战甲、沙罗之牙和月面狂风武器、赤影狼母冥魂头盔和带有永冻晶矿糙纹材质结构的虚空之壳外观、狼妖尾幻纹，以及月之狼群壁画。

descriptions.en: Put the fear of the Void into your foes with Sevagoth, the reaper of souls. Collection includes Sevagoth, Sevagoth Lucifuge helmet, Epitaph sidearm, Vithil Syandana and 3 day Affinity and Credit boosters.
descriptions.zh: 化身为灵魂收割者虚冥鬼影来把你的敌人带入虚空的恐惧中。该组合包内含虚冥鬼影战甲、虚冥鬼影避光头盔、葬铭副武器、威丝背饰和三天经验值与星币加成。

descriptions.en: The greatest journey begins with a single step. Prepare your arsenal for Wukong Qitian with this bundle containing the original forms of the Wukong Warframe and Sun & Moon dual blades.
descriptions.zh: 千里之行始于足下。通过这款包含齐天大圣战甲原始版本以及赤阳 & 幽月双刀的组合包为迎接齐天大圣做好准备。

descriptions.en: The youthful sovereign of the sea arises from the waves, attired for battle. Includes Yareli Warframe, Yareli Physalia Helmet, Kompressa Pistol, Merulina Syandana and 3-day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 风华正茂的深海主宰自海浪中升起，披挂上阵。该组合包内含咏浪之灵战甲、咏浪之灵蜇逸头盔、卡帕压力枪（手枪）、浪漪珊瑚背饰，以及 3 天经验值与星币加成。

descriptions.en: Why choose just one?
descriptions.zh: 为什么只要一个？

descriptions.en: A collection of Noggle Statues depicting the Grineer participants of Tactical Alert: Dog Days.
descriptions.zh: 一系列描绘战术警报：三伏天中克隆尼参与者的摇头娃娃。

names.zh: 三伏天摇头娃娃组合包

descriptions.en:
Tenno to battle stations! Instantly board your Railjack and set sail for the Proxima with this pack, featuring a fully-built Railjack, Railjack Skin and more.

- 250 Platinum
- Railjack
- Sungem Railjack Skin
- 4 Crew Slots
- 7-Day Resource Booster

Limited-time offer. Only one per account. Purchasing this pack will automatically complete the Archwing and Rising Tide Quest prerequisites needed to play Railjack. Both Quests can be replayed from the Codex aboard your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh:
天诺进入战位！通过这个组合包，即刻登上你的航道星舰，并启程前往比邻星域，这个组合包内含一艘完全打造好的航道星舰，航道星舰外观，以及更多精彩内容。

- 250 白金
- 航道星舰
- 耀阳航道星舰外观
- 4 个舰员槽位
- 7 天资源数量加成

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅限购买一次。购买这款组合包将自动完成《曲翼》和《澎湃狂潮》系列任务（游玩航道星舰任务所需要的前置条件）。你也可以通过轨道飞行器上的资料库来重玩这两个系列任务。

names.zh: 航道星舰即时成品组合包

descriptions.en:
A collection of weapon skins made by fellow Tenno, from the Warframe community.

Designs by: MaaYuu, Verifitas, ming1345, ZeroJackdaw, Rekkou, and StratoS117
descriptions.zh:
一组收藏了来自星际战甲社区，由以下天诺战士所设计的武器外观组合包。
 
天诺出品的设计者们：MaaYuu，Verifitas，ming1345，ZeroJackdaw，Rekkou，StratoS117

names.zh: 天诺工坊武器外观组合包

descriptions.en: A festive collection of Solstice skins for the Titania Warframe, Heliocor, Daedalus Armor, Salix Syandana, a Kavat Gene-Masking Kit and a Kubrow Gene-Masking Kit. Includes a 3-day Affinity and Credit booster.
descriptions.zh: 一套由幻蝶仙灵战甲、赫利俄光锤、代达罗斯护甲、柳树背饰、库娃基因组合包、库狛基因组合包等冬至外观所组成的节庆组合包。内含有 3 天经验与星币加成。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的投影收藏。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的投影收藏。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的投影收藏。

descriptions.en: This essential bundle contains everything you need to bring the Winter spirit to Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 这个重要的同捆包中拥有每一项你所需要能为战甲带来冬幕精神的道具。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Winter holidays in style! This bundle includes Mirage and a host of Winter-themed items.
descriptions.zh: 好好打扮来庆祝冬幕假期吧！这个组合包内含魅影精灵以​​及许多以冬幕为主题的道具。

descriptions.en: A collection of festive glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 节日用投影的组合包。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的投影收藏。

descriptions.en: Arca Armor that has been adorned with a festive design.
descriptions.zh: 带有节日气息的弧电护甲。

descriptions.en: Creation and destruction intermingle in this ethereal bundle for Wisp. Contains Wisp, her signature Fulmin lightning rifle, Sirocco Kavat Armor, the alternate Gaoth Helmet as well as 3-day credit and affinity boosters.
descriptions.zh: 创造和毁灭在这飘渺的组合包中交织在一起。此组合包内含幽灵、她的独特雷霆闪电步枪、西洛可库娃护甲、轻风替换头盔，以及 3 天星币和经验值加成。

descriptions.en: A bundle featuring a Man in the Wall and Albrecht Entrati Glyph from Community Artists SirEnarion & death_ma666ots
descriptions.zh: 组合包内含由社区艺术家 SirEnarion 和 death_ma666ots 设计的墙中人和阿尔布雷希特·英择谛投影。

names.en: Whispers in the Walls Community Glyph Bundle

descriptions.en: The signature battle armor of the only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
descriptions.zh: 能逃脱出土星六号最高戒备监狱的唯一可怕狂人的标志性战斗护甲。

descriptions.en: A pair of glyphs depicting the Wolf of Saturn Six.
descriptions.zh: 描绘着土星六号之狼的一对投影

names.en: Wolf of Saturn Six Glyph Bundle
names.zh: 土星六号之狼投影组合包

descriptions.en: The Yuvan Clerisy commissioned these golden statues to honor Lua's guardian pack. They are now yours to cherish. The collection includes the Steadfast Dynar Bust, Steadfast Raksh Bust, Steadfast Lycath Bust, and Steadfast Ulfrun Bust.
descriptions.zh: 青春仪使团授权制作了这些金色雕像来纪念守护月球的狼群。它们现在交给你珍惜。该组合包内含坚韧的戴拿半身铜像、坚韧的亚克什半身铜像、坚韧的莱卡斯半身铜像和坚韧的乌尔佛伦半身铜像。

descriptions.en: A collection of Immortal Wukong items, including Wukong Samadhi Skin, Meteor Whip Skin, and the Subhuti Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 齐天大圣不朽物品组合包，包含齐天大圣三摩提外观、流星鞭外观，以及须菩提背饰。

names.zh: 齐天大圣三摩提组合包

descriptions.en:
Adorn Wukong in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Wukong Voidshell Skin and Rubedo Impression material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含齐天大圣虚空之壳外观以及红色印象材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 齐天大圣虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en: Decorate your Orbiter with a complete set of Gallixware ceramics. Each piece was handcrafted by the esteemed Orokin artist, Bren Terrasiam. The bundle includes three vases, a plate, a bowl, and an amphora.
descriptions.zh: 用一整套高力士陶瓷装饰你的轨道飞行器。每件作品均由受人尊敬的奥罗金艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆手工制作而成。该组合包内含三个花瓶、一个盘子、一个碗和一个双耳瓶。

descriptions.en: Deck the Necralisk with these festive Tennobaum Glyphs!
descriptions.zh: 通过这些节庆天诺投影来装扮殁世幽都！

names.zh: 英择谛天诺投影组合包

descriptions.en: Pathfinders will use this collection well. Express the Zariman spirit of innovation with the Parallax Landing Craft and its four unique skins.
descriptions.zh: 探路者将会利用好这个组合包。通过星察登陆艇及其四种独特外观来表达扎里曼的创新精神。

descriptions.en:
Don morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes fifteen material structures.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 15 款材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 霍姆巴斯的虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Saryn Voidshell Skin, Volt Voidshell Skin, Rhino Voidshell Skin, each skin’s matching material structure, and fifteen additional materials structures.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含剧毒之触虚空之壳外观、伏特虚空之壳外观、狂野犀牛虚空之壳外观；以及每个外观的配套材质结构和十五种额外的材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。
